        fields=selected['files'];P.validate_control(fields['CONTROL.json'],fields['INPUTS.cms'],request,int(time.time()*1000))
        require_auth_enveloped(fields['INPUTS.cms'])
        metadata(budget,directory/'CONTROL.json',fields['CONTROL.json'],P.MAX_CONTROL)
        metadata(budget,directory/'CONTROL_PROVIDER.json',P.encode(selected['provider']),P.MAX_METADATA)
        metadata(budget,directory/'SELECTED_CONTROL.json',P.encode(dict(commit=selected['commit'],
          control_sha256=P.sha(fields['CONTROL.json']),ciphertext=P.descriptor(fields['INPUTS.cms']),reads=selected['reads'])),META_MAX)
        cipher=F.OutputFile(directory,'INPUTS.cms',P.MAX_CIPHERTEXT,budget);handles.append(cipher);cipher.write(fields['INPUTS.cms'])
        quarantine=F.OutputFile(directory,'quarantine.plain',C.MAX_PLAINTEXT_BYTES,budget);handles.append(quarantine)
        commands=Commands(binding,'host',directory,budget,session['deadline_monotonic'],P.sha(request))
        rc=commands.run('decrypt',dict(cipher=cipher,certificate=cert,key=key,quarantine=quarantine))
        bodies=accept_authenticated(rc,quarantine.read,binding['_index'],P.sha(request),core_value(binding))
        authenticated=True
        P.need(cipher.read()==fields['INPUTS.cms'] and cert.read()==certificate,'RECIPIENT_CLOSING_BODY_CHANGED')
        ensure_session(binding,ctx,directory)
        ref=api.get('ref',binding['control_branch'])
        P.need(ref.get('object',{}).get('sha')==selected['commit'],'CONTROL_CHANGED_BEFORE_INSTALL')
        budget.reserve(sum(row['bytes'] for row in binding['_index'].values()),len(binding['_index'])+len(F.directories(binding['_index'])))
        installed=F.stage(binding['_packet'],binding['_index'],bodies,P.parse(request,P.MAX_REQUEST)['nonce'])
        current_binding(binding);P.need(host_context(binding)==ctx,'CARRIER_HOST_CHANGED')
        F.recheck(binding['_packet']/'private-inputs',binding['_index'],installed,private=True)
        ref=api.get('ref',binding['control_branch'])
        P.need(ref.get('object',{}).get('sha')==selected['commit'],'CONTROL_CHANGED_AFTER_INSTALL')
    except BaseException as exc:
        stage_cleanup=getattr(exc,'stage_cleanup',None)
        error='CMS_AUTHENTICATION_REFUSED' if str(exc)=='CMS_AUTHENTICATION_REFUSED' else 'INPUT_RECEIVING_REFUSED'
    cleanup=[]
    for handle in handles:
        if handle.closed:continue
        if error is None and installed is not None and handle.name in ('recipient.pem','INPUTS.cms'):
            try:
                handle.retain_close();cleanup.append(dict(name=handle.name,retained_public_body=True,descriptor_closed=True))
                continue
            except BaseException:error='CURRENTNESS_REFUSED'
        cleanup.append(handle.cleanup())
    if error is not None and installed is not None:
        stage_cleanup=F.discard_stage(binding['_packet']/'private-inputs',binding['_index'],installed)
    complete=reserved and private_secrets_absent(directory) and all((row.get('unlinked') or row.get('retained_public_body')) and row['descriptor_closed'] for row in cleanup) and (commands is None or commands.closed())
    if stage_cleanup is not None:
        cleanup.append(dict(stage_cleanup=stage_cleanup));complete=complete and stage_cleanup['complete']
    if not complete:error='CLEANUP_REFUSED'
    if error is None and installed is not None:
        try:
            P.need(time.monotonic()<session['deadline_monotonic'],'CARRIER_ACQUISITION_EXPIRED')
            current_binding(binding);P.need(host_context(binding)==ctx and host_identity()==session['host_identity'],'CARRIER_HOST_CHANGED')
            F.recheck(binding['_packet']/'private-inputs',binding['_index'],installed,private=True)
            retained=retained_receiving(binding,directory,request)
            ready=dict(schema='dg16.actual-core-private-inputs-ready.v1',authority='NONE',context=ctx,
               host_identity=session['host_identity'],directory_identity=session['directory_identity'],
               binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),request_sha256=P.sha(request),control_commit=selected['commit'],
               input_index_sha256=C.check_index(binding['_index']),installed=installed,authenticated=True,
               cleanup_complete=True,carrier_elapsed_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-session['started_monotonic_ns'],
               retained_bodies=retained,deadline_monotonic=session['deadline_monotonic'],core_or_native_effect_grant=False,original_awards=[])
            metadata(budget,directory/'READY.json',P.encode(ready),META_MAX)
            host_usage(binding,ctx,directory,installed)
        except BaseException:error='CURRENTNESS_REFUSED'
    result=safe_outcome('INPUTS_READY' if error is None and installed is not None else 'REFUSED',
       'ACQUIRED' if error is None and installed is not None else (error or 'PRE_ENTRY_REFUSED'),request,
       authenticated,installed is not None,complete,started)
    if reserved:save_outcome(directory,result,cleanup,budget)
    return result

def successful_terminal(outcome,request_sha256):
    """A successful label cannot override contradictory closing evidence."""
    P.exact(outcome,('schema','authority','public','owned_cleanup','original_awards'))
    P.need(outcome['schema']=='dg16.private-carrier-terminal-custody.v1' and outcome['authority']=='NONE'
      and outcome['original_awards']==[],'CARRIER_TERMINAL_SCOPE')
    public=outcome['public']
    P.exact(public,('schema','authority','status','code','request_sha256','authenticated','staged',
      'cleanup_complete','elapsed_ns','original_awards'))
    expected=P.public_result('INPUTS_READY','ACQUIRED',request_sha256,True,True,True,public['elapsed_ns'])
    P.need(P.encode(public)==P.encode(expected),'CARRIER_TERMINAL_SUCCESS_CONJUNCTION')
    expected_cleanup=[
      dict(name='recipient.key',unlinked=True,descriptor_closed=True,identity_confirmed=True),
      dict(name='recipient.pem',retained_public_body=True,descriptor_closed=True),
      dict(name='INPUTS.cms',retained_public_body=True,descriptor_closed=True),
      dict(name='quarantine.plain',unlinked=True,descriptor_closed=True,identity_confirmed=True)]
    P.need(P.encode(outcome['owned_cleanup'])==P.encode(expected_cleanup),'CARRIER_TERMINAL_OWNED_CLEANUP')
    return True

def require_ready():
    """Call in the same host immediately before unchanged core require_launch."""
    binding=P.load();ctx=host_context(binding);directory=session_path(binding,ctx)
    actual_tools=HT.ResolvedTools(binding,ctx,'prepare',os.environ.get('DG16_CARRIER_READ_TOKEN'))
    ready=receipt_raw(directory/'READY.json');outcome=receipt_raw(directory/'OUTCOME.json')
    P.exact(ready,('schema','authority','context','host_identity','directory_identity','binding_sha256','request_sha256',
       'control_commit','input_index_sha256','installed','authenticated','cleanup_complete','carrier_elapsed_ns',
       'retained_bodies','deadline_monotonic','core_or_native_effect_grant','original_awards'))
    P.need(type(ready['control_commit']) is str and P.re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',ready['control_commit']),
      'CARRIER_READY_CONTROL_COMMIT')
    P.need(ready.get('schema')=='dg16.actual-core-private-inputs-ready.v1' and ready.get('authority')=='NONE' and ready.get('context')==ctx
      and ready.get('host_identity')==host_identity() and ready.get('binding_sha256')==P.sha(binding['_binding_raw'])
      and ready.get('directory_identity')==F.directory_id(directory.lstat())
      and ready.get('input_index_sha256')==C.check_index(binding['_index']) and ready.get('authenticated') is True
      and ready.get('cleanup_complete') is True and ready.get('core_or_native_effect_grant') is False
      and ready.get('original_awards')==[],'CARRIER_READY_SCOPE')
    P.need((directory/'CONSUME_RESERVED.json').is_file() and not (directory/'recipient.key').exists()
      and not (directory/'quarantine.plain').exists(),'CARRIER_SECRET_DISPOSAL')
    request,_=F.read_file(directory/'REQUEST.json',P.MAX_REQUEST,private=True)
    P.need(P.sha(request)==ready['request_sha256'],'CARRIER_READY_REQUEST')
    successful_terminal(outcome,P.sha(request))
    q=P.parse(request,P.MAX_REQUEST)
    P.need(int(time.time()*1000)<=q['expires_unix_ms'] and time.monotonic()<ready['deadline_monotonic'],'CARRIER_READY_EXPIRED')
    P.need(retained_receiving(binding,directory,request,ready['control_commit'])==ready['retained_bodies'],
      'CARRIER_RETAINED_PHYSICAL_CHANGED')
    bodies,observed=F.acquire(binding['_packet']/'private-inputs',binding['_index'],private=True)
    P.need(observed==ready['installed'],'CARRIER_READY_PHYSICAL_CHANGED')
    P.check_inputs(binding['_index'],bodies,core_value(binding));current_binding(binding)
    actual_tools.recheck('CLOSE')
    host_usage(binding,ctx,directory,observed)
    return dict(status='RECEIVED_EXACT_PRIVATE_INPUT_AVAILABILITY',authority='NONE',input_index_sha256=ready['input_index_sha256'],
        request_sha256=ready['request_sha256'],control_commit=ready['control_commit'],original_awards=[],core_or_native_effect_grant=False)

"""Ordinary finite files and same-identity staging; no controller or network."""
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat
import bundle_codec as C

need=C.need

def stamp(s):
    return [s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns,s.st_uid,s.st_gid]

def directory_id(s):return [s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_gid]

def parents(path):
    result=[]
    for parent in reversed(Path(path).absolute().parents):
        st=parent.lstat();need(stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) and not parent.is_symlink(),'PHYSICAL_PARENT_ALIAS')
        result.append([str(parent),*directory_id(st)])
    return result

def read_file(path,maximum,private=False):
    path=Path(path).absolute();ancestry=parents(path);before=path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink==1 and 0<=before.st_size<=maximum,'PHYSICAL_FILE_SHAPE')
    if private:need(before.st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode)==0o600,'PRIVATE_FILE_CUSTODY')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        need(stamp(os.fstat(fd))==stamp(before) and not os.listxattr(fd),'PHYSICAL_OPEN_CHANGED')
        chunks=[];count=0
        while True:
            raw=os.read(fd,min(1024*1024,maximum-count+1))
            if not raw:break
            count+=len(raw);need(count<=maximum,'PHYSICAL_FILE_BOUND');chunks.append(raw)
        raw=b''.join(chunks)
        need(len(raw)==before.st_size and stamp(os.fstat(fd))==stamp(before)
          and stamp(path.lstat())==stamp(before) and parents(path)==ancestry,'PHYSICAL_CLOSING_CHANGED')
        return raw,dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=C.sha(raw),identity=stamp(before),ancestors=ancestry)
    finally:os.close(fd)

def directories(index):
    result={'.'}
    for name in index:
        result.update(p.as_posix() for p in PurePosixPath(name).parents)
    return result

def acquire(root,index,private=False):
    C.check_index(index);root=Path(root).absolute();wanted_dirs=directories(index)
    observed_files=set();observed_dirs={};body={};files={}
    for parent,dirs,names in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
        path=Path(parent);rel=path.relative_to(root).as_posix();st=path.lstat()
        need(rel in wanted_dirs and stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),'PHYSICAL_DIRECTORY_POPULATION')
        if private:need(st.st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o700,'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
        need(not os.listxattr(path),'PHYSICAL_DIRECTORY_ATTRIBUTES')
        observed_dirs[rel]=directory_id(st)
        for name in dirs:
            child=path/name;key=child.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            need(key in wanted_dirs and not child.is_symlink(),'PHYSICAL_DIRECTORY_POPULATION')
        for name in names:
            key=(path/name).relative_to(root).as_posix()
            need(key in index and key not in observed_files,'PHYSICAL_FILE_POPULATION')
            raw,row=read_file(path/name,C.MAX_FILE_BYTES,private)
            need({k:row[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')}==index[key],'PHYSICAL_BODY_PIN')
            body[key]=raw;files[key]=row;observed_files.add(key)
        need(len(observed_files)+len(observed_dirs)<=C.MAX_ENTRIES*6+1,'PHYSICAL_POPULATION_BOUND')
    need(observed_files==set(index) and set(observed_dirs)==wanted_dirs,'PHYSICAL_EXACT_POPULATION')
    closing={name:directory_id((root if name=='.' else root/name).lstat()) for name in wanted_dirs}
    need(closing==observed_dirs,'PHYSICAL_DIRECTORY_CHANGED')
    return body,dict(files=files,directories=observed_dirs,total_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in files.values()))

def recheck(root,index,opening,private=False):
    _,closing=acquire(root,index,private)
    need(closing==opening,'PHYSICAL_CLOSING_CHANGED');return closing

class Budget:
    def __init__(self,byte_limit,entry_limit):
        self.byte_limit=byte_limit;self.entry_limit=entry_limit;self.bytes=0;self.entries=0
    def reserve(self,count,entries=1):
        need(type(count) is int and type(entries) is int and count>=0 and entries>=0,'RESERVATION_SHAPE')
        need(self.bytes+count<=self.byte_limit and self.entries+entries<=self.entry_limit,'CARRIER_ALLOCATION_BOUND')
        self.bytes+=count;self.entries+=entries

def private_directory(path):
    path=Path(path);path.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
    st=path.lstat();need(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o700 and st.st_uid==os.geteuid(),'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:need(directory_id(os.fstat(fd))==directory_id(st) and not os.listxattr(fd),'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_OPEN_CHANGED')
    except BaseException:os.close(fd);raise
    return fd,directory_id(st)

def write_once(path,raw,maximum=1024*1024):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and len(raw)<=maximum,'PRIVATE_WRITE_BOUND')
    path=Path(path);ancestry=parents(path)
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600)
    try:
        os.fchmod(fd,0o600);offset=0
        while offset<len(raw):
            written=os.write(fd,raw[offset:]);need(written>0,'PRIVATE_SHORT_WRITE');offset+=written
        os.fsync(fd)
        need(parents(path)==ancestry,'PRIVATE_WRITE_PARENT_CHANGED')
    finally:os.close(fd)
    body,row=read_file(path,maximum,private=True);need(body==raw,'PRIVATE_WRITE_READBACK');return row

def reserve(directory,name,raw):
    need(name in ('RECIPIENT_RESERVED.json','SEND_RESERVED.json','CONSUME_RESERVED.json'),'RESERVATION_NAME')
    row=write_once(Path(directory)/name,raw,65536)
    fd=os.open(directory,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:os.fsync(fd)
    finally:os.close(fd)
    return row

class OutputFile:
    """Retained FD for an owned command output; /proc paths never select data."""
    def __init__(self,parent,name,maximum,budget):
        need(name in ('recipient.key','recipient.pem','bundle.plain','quarantine.plain','INPUTS.cms'),'COMMAND_FILE_NAME')
        budget.reserve(maximum)
        self.parent=Path(parent);self.name=name;self.maximum=maximum
        self.parent_fd=os.open(self.parent,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
        self.parent_id=directory_id(os.fstat(self.parent_fd))
        try:
            need(os.fstat(self.parent_fd).st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(self.parent_fd).st_mode)==0o700,'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
            self.fd=os.open(name,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600,dir_fd=self.parent_fd)
        except BaseException:
            os.close(self.parent_fd);raise
        self.identity=directory_id(os.fstat(self.fd));self.closed=False
        try:os.fchmod(self.fd,0o600);self.identity=directory_id(os.fstat(self.fd))
        except BaseException:
            self.cleanup();raise
    @property
    def proc_path(self):return '/proc/self/fd/'+str(self.fd)
    def current(self):
        info=os.fstat(self.fd)
        need(directory_id(info)==self.identity and info.st_nlink==1 and info.st_size<=self.maximum
             and not os.listxattr(self.fd),'COMMAND_OUTPUT_CUSTODY')
        need(directory_id(os.stat(self.name,dir_fd=self.parent_fd,follow_symlinks=False))==self.identity
             and directory_id(self.parent.lstat())==self.parent_id,'COMMAND_OUTPUT_PATH_CHANGED')
        return info
    def write(self,raw):
        need(type(raw) is bytes and len(raw)<=self.maximum and self.current().st_size==0,'COMMAND_INPUT_WRITE')
        count=0
        while count<len(raw):
            got=os.write(self.fd,raw[count:]);need(got>0,'COMMAND_INPUT_WRITE');count+=got
        os.fsync(self.fd);need(self.read()==raw,'COMMAND_INPUT_READBACK')
    def read(self):
        before=stamp(self.current());raw=os.pread(self.fd,self.maximum+1,0)
        need(len(raw)<=self.maximum and len(raw)==before[4] and stamp(self.current())==before,'COMMAND_OUTPUT_CHANGED')
        return raw
    def cleanup(self):
        outcome=dict(name=self.name,unlinked=False,descriptor_closed=False,identity_confirmed=False)
        try:
            current=os.stat(self.name,dir_fd=self.parent_fd,follow_symlinks=False)
            need(directory_id(current)==self.identity and current.st_nlink==1,'CLEANUP_FOREIGN_MEMBER_REFUSED')
            outcome['identity_confirmed']=True
            os.unlink(self.name,dir_fd=self.parent_fd);os.fsync(self.parent_fd);outcome['unlinked']=True
        except (OSError,ValueError):outcome['refusal']='OWNED_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED'
        finally:
            if not self.closed:
                os.close(self.fd);os.close(self.parent_fd);self.closed=True
            outcome['descriptor_closed']=True
        return outcome

    def retain_close(self):
        self.current();os.fsync(self.fd)
        os.close(self.fd);os.close(self.parent_fd);self.closed=True

class HeldFile(OutputFile):
    """Reacquire only a named held recipient with its full original identity."""
    def __init__(self,parent,name,expected,maximum):
        need(name in ('recipient.key','recipient.pem'),'HELD_RECIPIENT_NAME')
        self.parent=Path(parent);self.name=name;self.maximum=maximum;self.closed=False
        _,row=read_file(self.parent/name,maximum,private=True)
        need(row==expected,'HELD_RECIPIENT_CHANGED')
        self.parent_fd=os.open(self.parent,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
        self.parent_id=directory_id(os.fstat(self.parent_fd))
        try:self.fd=os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,dir_fd=self.parent_fd)
        except BaseException:os.close(self.parent_fd);raise
        self.identity=directory_id(os.fstat(self.fd))
        try:
            need(stamp(os.fstat(self.fd))==expected['identity'],'HELD_RECIPIENT_CHANGED')
            need(C.sha(self.read())==expected['sha256'],'HELD_RECIPIENT_CHANGED')
        except BaseException:
            os.close(self.fd);os.close(self.parent_fd);self.closed=True;raise

def private_usage(directory,maximum):
    """Flat carrier session only. Unknown subdirectories are never ignored."""
    directory=Path(directory);info=directory.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700
      and info.st_uid==os.geteuid() and not directory.is_symlink(),'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
    total=0;count=1
    for child in directory.iterdir():
        _,row=read_file(child,maximum,private=True);total+=row['bytes'];count+=1
        need(total<=80*1024**2 and count<=1600,'CARRIER_ALLOCATION_BOUND')
    return total,count

def rename_noreplace(parent,staging,target):
    """Future Linux ordinary-file primitive, never called by author controls."""
    import ctypes
    libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
    call=libc.renameat2
    call.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_uint]
    call.restype=ctypes.c_int
    fd=os.open(parent,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        need('/' not in staging and target=='private-inputs','ATOMIC_TARGET_SCOPE')
        rc=call(fd,os.fsencode(staging),fd,os.fsencode(target),1) # RENAME_NOREPLACE
        if rc:raise ValueError('ATOMIC_NOREPLACE_REFUSED')
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:os.close(fd)

def discard_stage(root,index,opening):
    """Delete only the exact acquired owned tree; foreign replacement refuses."""
    root=Path(root);outcomes=[]
    try:
        recheck(root,index,opening,private=True)
        for name,row in sorted(opening['files'].items(),reverse=True):
            path=root/name;parent_fd=os.open(path.parent,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            fd=None
            try:
                fd=os.open(path.name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK,dir_fd=parent_fd)
                need(stamp(os.fstat(fd))==row['identity'] and stamp(os.stat(path.name,dir_fd=parent_fd,follow_symlinks=False))==row['identity'],
                     'STAGE_CLEANUP_FOREIGN_MEMBER')
                os.unlink(path.name,dir_fd=parent_fd);os.fsync(parent_fd)
                outcomes.append(dict(name=name,unlinked=True))
            finally:
                if fd is not None:os.close(fd)
                os.close(parent_fd)
        for name in sorted(opening['directories'],key=lambda n:(len(PurePosixPath(n).parts),n),reverse=True):
            path=root if name=='.' else root/name
            need(directory_id(path.lstat())==opening['directories'][name] and not list(path.iterdir()),'STAGE_CLEANUP_DIRECTORY_CHANGED')
            path.rmdir();outcomes.append(dict(name=name,directory_removed=True))
        return dict(complete=True,outcomes=outcomes,retained_private_stage=False)
    except (OSError,ValueError):
        return dict(complete=False,outcomes=outcomes,retained_private_stage=True,refusal='STAGE_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED')

def stage(packet,index,bodies,nonce):
    C.check_index(index);C.check_request(nonce)
    need(type(bodies) is dict and set(bodies)==set(index),'STAGE_POPULATION')
    packet=Path(packet);target=packet/'private-inputs';staging=packet/('.private-inputs-'+nonce)
    need(not target.exists() and not target.is_symlink() and not staging.exists(),'STAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS')
    info=packet.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not packet.is_symlink() and info.st_uid==os.geteuid()
      and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700 and not os.listxattr(packet),'PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
    packet_before=directory_id(info);ancestry=parents(packet/'marker')
    budget=Budget(C.MAX_TOTAL_BYTES,C.MAX_ENTRIES*6+1)
    needed=directories(index);budget.reserve(0,len(needed))
    for name,row in index.items():
        need(type(bodies[name]) is bytes and dict(bytes=len(bodies[name]),sha256=C.sha(bodies[name]))==row,'STAGE_BODY_PIN')
        budget.reserve(len(bodies[name]))
    staging.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False);opening=None;published=False
    try:
        for name in sorted(needed-{'.'},key=lambda n:(len(PurePosixPath(n).parts),n)):(staging/name).mkdir(mode=0o700)
        for name,raw in sorted(bodies.items()):write_once(staging/name,raw,C.MAX_FILE_BYTES)
        _,opening=acquire(staging,index,private=True)
        for name in needed:
            fd=os.open(staging if name=='.' else staging/name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            try:os.fsync(fd)
            finally:os.close(fd)
        need(directory_id(packet.lstat())==packet_before and parents(packet/'marker')==ancestry,'STAGE_PARENT_CHANGED')
        rename_noreplace(packet,staging.name,target.name);published=True
        _,closing=acquire(target,index,private=True)
        # Rename changes absolute ancestry/root ctime, not member inode/body.
        need(closing['directories']==opening['directories'],'STAGE_DIRECTORY_IDENTITY_CHANGED')
        for name,row in opening['files'].items():
            need({k:row[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256','identity')}==
                 {k:closing['files'][name][k] for k in ('bytes','sha256','identity')},'STAGE_MEMBER_CHANGED')
        need(directory_id(packet.lstat())==packet_before,'STAGE_PARENT_CHANGED')
        return closing
    except BaseException as cause:
        # A partial write or uncertain rename is quarantined when its entire
        # actual owned population cannot be received. Never sweep by pathname.
        cleanup=(discard_stage(staging,index,opening) if opening is not None and not published and staging.exists() else
                 dict(complete=False,outcomes=[],retained_private_stage=True,refusal='PARTIAL_OR_PUBLICATION_CUSTODY_UNRECEIVED'))
        error=ValueError('PRIVATE_STAGE_REFUSED');error.stage_cleanup=cleanup
        raise error from cause

"""Load exactly the reviewed carrier bodies in a fresh isolated interpreter.

The enclosing immutable workflow and external entry bind this loader. The
loader binds the implementation bodies; no implementation imports this file.
"""
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import sys
import types

MODULE_PINS = {'bundle_codec': {'bytes': 4404, 'sha256': '81b4494e8940f9f4a70d7359f689c099caa1a152aa6afd71008183fb2b5fd2aa'}, 'carrier_policy': {'bytes': 13481, 'sha256': '6136346972951f6a9d738087b5004a1d08cb1b2a6cbe352b2ad93bfa76a3707e'}, 'carrier_io': {'bytes': 15576, 'sha256': '779461deb44bf0192a4253c9a257926e23b6ab73cf5da602d0dc86a31e90d274'}, 'provider_reader': {'bytes': 19139, 'sha256': '9d1a2624796f98127214d990acbfe72e0d6f2b7a603d739ace39678e44d66726'}, 'sender_policy': {'bytes': 4707, 'sha256': '2826b3a2293e9840f6a5c3627d53c2a7295aa336da70e96444df14ec937c0303'}, 'sender_capture': {'bytes': 16748, 'sha256': '232bfdfc2ad7edbbce125110518ac2ce60fc5044b00614d6b4c472c2054e783e'}, 'tool_broker': {'bytes': 19693, 'sha256': '1157d3466630218093ace25ea1704c15653092b5f0aa62ff5c3254ad25afebd9'}, 'host_tools': {'bytes': 26922, 'sha256': '876aeb6af4c5c40bc234409c60ee3d6d73421c28fbd73ef07ab212a11b501e5c'}, 'carrier': {'bytes': 42835, 'sha256': '8abaec881996c34f79ccb83616e59b4a601504e137d1165b64dc1430823e6dba'}}
ORDER = ('bundle_codec', 'carrier_policy', 'carrier_io', 'provider_reader', 'sender_policy', 'sender_capture', 'tool_broker', 'host_tools', 'carrier')
_CACHE=None

def need(ok,code):
    if not ok:raise ValueError(code)

def stamp(s):return [s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns,s.st_uid,s.st_gid]

def parents(path):
    result=[]
    for p in reversed(path.parents):
        s=p.lstat();need(stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink(),'LOADER_PARENT_ALIAS')
        result.append([str(p),s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_gid])
    return result

def read(path):
    path=path.absolute();ancestry=parents(path);before=path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink==1 and 0<before.st_size<=1024*1024
      and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) in (0o400,0o444,0o644),'LOADER_SOURCE_SHAPE')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_CLOEXEC|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    try:
        need(stamp(os.fstat(fd))==stamp(before) and not os.listxattr(fd),'LOADER_OPEN_CHANGED')
        raw=os.pread(fd,1024*1024+1,0)
        need(len(raw)==before.st_size and stamp(os.fstat(fd))==stamp(before)
          and stamp(path.lstat())==stamp(before) and parents(path)==ancestry,'LOADER_CLOSING_CHANGED')
        return raw,dict(identity=stamp(before),ancestors=ancestry)
    finally:os.close(fd)

def read_all():
    need(set(MODULE_PINS)==set(ORDER),'LOADER_MODULE_POPULATION')
    base=Path(__file__).absolute().parent;bodies={};records={}
    for name in ORDER:
        raw,record=read(base/(name+'.py'))
        need(MODULE_PINS[name]==dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()),'LOADER_BODY_PIN')
        bodies[name]=raw;records[name]=record
    return bodies,records

def current():
    need(_CACHE is not None,'LOADER_NOT_LOADED')
    bodies,records=read_all()
    need(bodies==_CACHE['bodies'] and records==_CACHE['records'],'LOADER_CURRENTNESS')
    need(all(sys.modules.get(n) is m for n,m in _CACHE['modules'].items()),'LOADER_MODULE_REPLACED')
    return True

def load():
    global _CACHE
    need(sys.flags.isolated==1 and sys.dont_write_bytecode is True,'LOADER_FRESH_ISOLATED_INTERPRETER_REQUIRED')
    if _CACHE is not None:current();return _CACHE['public']
    bodies,records=read_all()
    need(not any(name in sys.modules for name in ORDER),'LOADER_PREEXISTING_MODULE_REFUSED')
    made={};base=Path(__file__).absolute().parent
    try:
        for name in ORDER:
            module=types.ModuleType(name);module.__file__=str(base/(name+'.py'))
            sys.modules[name]=module;made[name]=module
            exec(compile(bodies[name],module.__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
        public=types.SimpleNamespace(codec=made['bundle_codec'],policy=made['carrier_policy'],
          files=made['carrier_io'],provider=made['provider_reader'],carrier=made['carrier'],
          sender_policy=made['sender_policy'],sender_capture=made['sender_capture'],tool_broker=made['tool_broker'],host_tools=made['host_tools'])
        _CACHE=dict(bodies=bodies,records=records,modules=made,public=public)
        made['carrier']._LOADER_CURRENT=current
        current();return public
    except BaseException:
        _CACHE=None
        for name,module in made.items():
            if sys.modules.get(name) is module:del sys.modules[name]
        raise

import json

         'native_applicability_adoption':'COMPOSITION_NATIVE_APPLICABILITY_ADOPTION.json'}
RETAINED = {'SOURCE_ACQUISITION.json': {'bytes': 198602, 'sha256': '8c3b2ddace7802d91308121f2d3f2b8f236fd5d443dcd2237164e20665cd3319'}, 'PACKAGE_ROOT_RECEIVING.json': {'bytes': 928, 'sha256': '0edff0f3d8bd6f5520ef72d4e91daba54a6b0033e85b94f041f448c2951d6691'}, 'PACKAGE_BODY_RECEIVING.json': {'bytes': 9744, 'sha256': '8c592c76967ae2d95101af86ca25ab3bd4d09acdad486afbb976d61e7e5a7811'}, 'PACKAGE_TERMINAL_RECEIVING.json': {'bytes': 4531, 'sha256': 'e213b8843f03741c48776277f9e1db8c78ea1d3f7609875ce32bcd94e5ed5b89'}}
BODY_NAMES = ('HOST_COMPOSITION.json','host_composition.py','run.py','NATIVE_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY.json','host_utility.py')

need, sha, encode = C.need, C.sha, C.encode

def descriptor(raw): return dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw))

def parse(raw, maximum, canonical=True):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= maximum,'CARRIER_JSON_BOUND')
    def pairs(rows):
        result={}
        for key,value in rows:
            need(key not in result,'CARRIER_DUPLICATE_KEY');result[key]=value
        return result
    try:
        value=json.loads(raw,object_pairs_hook=pairs,
            parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('CARRIER_NONFINITE_JSON')))
    except (UnicodeError,json.JSONDecodeError,RecursionError) as exc:
        raise ValueError('CARRIER_JSON_REFUSED') from exc
    if canonical:need(encode(value)==raw,'CARRIER_NONCANONICAL_JSON')
    return value

def exact(value, keys, code='CARRIER_FIELDS'):
    need(type(value) is dict and set(value)==set(keys),code)

def digest(value): need(type(value) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',value),'CARRIER_DIGEST')
def integer(value, low, high, code='CARRIER_INTEGER'):
    need(type(value) is int and low<=value<=high,code)

def context(value):
    exact(value,CONTEXT_KEYS)
    need(value['repository']==REPOSITORY and value['run_attempt']==1 and type(value['run_attempt']) is int,'CARRIER_CONTEXT')
    need(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]{0,19}',value['run_id']) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',value['workflow_commit']),'CARRIER_RUN')
    need(re.fullmatch(r'pro/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_-]{0,180}',value['branch'])
         and '..' not in value['branch'] and '//' not in value['branch'],'CARRIER_BRANCH')
    need(re.fullmatch(r'\.github/workflows/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,100}\.ya?ml',value['workflow_path'])
         and re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,79}',value['job_name']),'CARRIER_WORKFLOW')
    return value

def fixed_host_paths(ctx):
    context(ctx)
    island=Path('/dg16-g1-'+ctx['run_id'])
    return dict(island=island,packet=island/'packet',source=island/'source',output=island/'output',
      receipt=island/'ROOT_PLACEMENT_RECEIPT.json')

def check_inputs(index, bodies, core):
    pin=C.check_index(index)
    need(type(bodies) is dict and set(bodies)==set(index),'ACTUAL_INPUT_POPULATION')
    for name,row in RETAINED.items(): need(index.get(name)==row,'RETAINED_INPUT_PIN')
    need(core.get('schema')=='dg16.current-g1-g3-fixed-root-core-composition.v2'
         and core.get('state')=='REVIEWED_EXACT_COMPOSITION' and core.get('component_scope')==SCOPE
         and core.get('source_commit')==SOURCE_COMMIT and core.get('source_tree')==SOURCE_TREE,'CARRIER_CORE_SCOPE')
    for role,name in ROLES.items():
        expected=core.get(role)
        need(type(expected) is dict and expected==dict(path='private-inputs/'+name,**index.get(name,{})),
             'CARRIER_COMPOSITION_BODY_BINDING')
    for name,row in index.items():
        need(type(bodies[name]) is bytes and descriptor(bodies[name])==row,'ACTUAL_INPUT_BODY_CHANGED')
    # The placement index may use the core's pretty canonical form; its exact
    # admitted body digest, rather than a reserialization, is the binding.
    try: placement=parse(bodies[ROLES['placement_evidence_index']],C.MAX_FILE_BYTES,canonical=False)
    except (ValueError,UnicodeError,RecursionError) as exc:raise ValueError('PLACEMENT_INDEX_JSON') from exc
    need(type(placement) is dict and set(placement)=={'schema','scope','members'}
         and placement['schema']=='dg16.received-placement-evidence-index.v1','PLACEMENT_INDEX_FIELDS')
    members=placement['members'];C.check_index(members)
    need(all(name.startswith('placement/') for name in members),'PLACEMENT_INDEX_PREFIX')
    need(set(index)==set(RETAINED)|set(ROLES.values())|set(members),'CARRIER_EXACT_INPUT_POPULATION')
    need(all(index[name]==row for name,row in members.items()),'PLACEMENT_ACTUAL_BODY_BINDING')
    return pin

def make_request(ctx,index,cert,nonce,issued_ms,expires_ms):
    context(ctx);digest(nonce)
    need(type(cert) is bytes and 0<len(cert)<=MAX_CERTIFICATE,'RECIPIENT_CERTIFICATE_BOUND')
    integer(issued_ms,0,10**16);integer(expires_ms,issued_ms+1,issued_ms+MAX_ACQUISITION_SECONDS*1000)
    value=dict(schema='dg16.core-private-recipient-request.v1',authority='NONE',component_scope=SCOPE,
      source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,source_tree=SOURCE_TREE,**ctx,input_index_sha256=C.check_index(index),
      input_count=len(index),input_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in index.values()),recipient_sha256=sha(cert),
      nonce=nonce,issued_unix_ms=issued_ms,expires_unix_ms=expires_ms,automatic_retry=False,original_awards=[])
    raw=encode(value);need(len(raw)<=MAX_REQUEST,'REQUEST_BOUND');return raw

def validate_request(raw,cert,ctx,index,now_ms):
    value=parse(raw,MAX_REQUEST)
    expected=make_request(ctx,index,cert,value.get('nonce'),value.get('issued_unix_ms'),value.get('expires_unix_ms'))
    need(raw==expected,'REQUEST_EXACT_CONTEXT')
    integer(now_ms,value['issued_unix_ms'],value['expires_unix_ms'],'REQUEST_EXPIRED_OR_FUTURE')
    return value

def make_control(request_raw,cipher,provider_receipt_sha256,issued_ms):
    q=parse(request_raw,MAX_REQUEST);digest(provider_receipt_sha256)
    need(type(cipher) is bytes and 0<len(cipher)<=MAX_CIPHERTEXT,'CIPHERTEXT_BOUND')
    integer(issued_ms,q['issued_unix_ms'],q['expires_unix_ms'],'CONTROL_TIME')
    value=dict(schema='dg16.core-private-ciphertext-control.v1',authority='NONE',component_scope=SCOPE,
       **{k:q[k] for k in CONTEXT_KEYS},source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,source_tree=SOURCE_TREE,
       request_sha256=sha(request_raw),recipient_sha256=q['recipient_sha256'],nonce=q['nonce'],
       input_index_sha256=q['input_index_sha256'],ciphertext=descriptor(cipher),
       provider_receipt_sha256=provider_receipt_sha256,issued_unix_ms=issued_ms,original_awards=[])
    raw=encode(value);need(len(raw)<=MAX_CONTROL,'CONTROL_BOUND');return raw

def validate_control(raw,cipher,request_raw,now_ms):
    v=parse(raw,MAX_CONTROL);q=parse(request_raw,MAX_REQUEST)
    expected=make_control(request_raw,cipher,v.get('provider_receipt_sha256'),v.get('issued_unix_ms'))
    need(raw==expected,'CONTROL_EXACT_FRESH_BINDING')
    integer(now_ms,v['issued_unix_ms'],q['expires_unix_ms'],'CONTROL_EXPIRED_OR_FUTURE')
    return v

def public_result(status,code,request_sha256,authenticated,staged,cleanup_complete,elapsed_ns):
    need(status in ('REQUEST_READY','PAYLOAD_READY','INPUTS_READY','REFUSED'),'PUBLIC_STATUS')
    need(code in ('ACQUIRED','PRE_ENTRY_REFUSED','CMS_AUTHENTICATION_REFUSED','INPUT_RECEIVING_REFUSED',
         'CONTROL_REFUSED','CURRENTNESS_REFUSED','CLEANUP_REFUSED','INTERRUPTED','TOOL_OR_CAPTURE_REFUSED',
         'DEADLINE_EXPIRED','RESERVATION_REFUSED'),'PUBLIC_CODE')
    if request_sha256 is None:need(status=='REFUSED','PUBLIC_MISSING_REQUEST')
    else:digest(request_sha256)
    integer(elapsed_ns,0,10**16)
    need(all(type(v) is bool for v in (authenticated,staged,cleanup_complete)),'PUBLIC_BOOLEAN')
    return dict(schema='dg16.core-private-carrier-result.v1',authority='NONE',status=status,code=code,
       request_sha256=request_sha256,authenticated=authenticated,staged=staged,cleanup_complete=cleanup_complete,
       elapsed_ns=elapsed_ns,original_awards=[])

def load():
    import carrier_io as F
    base=Path(__file__).absolute().parent
    raw,binding_record=F.read_file(base/'CARRIER_COMPOSITION.json',MAX_INDEX)
    need(sha(raw)==BINDING_SHA256,'CARRIER_BINDING_PIN')
    v=parse(raw,MAX_INDEX)
    need(v.get('state')=='REVIEWED_EXACT_CARRIER_COMPOSITION','CARRIER_COMPOSITION_UNRESOLVED')
    exact(v,('schema','state','repository','source_commit','source_tree','component_scope','branch',
      'workflow_path','workflow_sha256','job_name','control_branch','control_parent','core_bodies',
      'input_index','carrier_admission','placement_body','host_tools','root_tools','limits','original_awards'))
    need(v['schema']=='dg16.core-private-carrier-composition.v2' and v['repository']==REPOSITORY
      and v['source_commit']==SOURCE_COMMIT and v['source_tree']==SOURCE_TREE and v['component_scope']==SCOPE
      and v['original_awards']==[],'CARRIER_COMPOSITION_SCOPE')
    context(dict(repository=REPOSITORY,branch=v['branch'],workflow_commit='0'*40,workflow_path=v['workflow_path'],
       run_id='1',run_attempt=1,job_name=v['job_name']))
    digest(v['workflow_sha256']);need(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',v['control_parent']),'CONTROL_INITIAL_COMMIT')
    need(re.fullmatch(r'pro/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_-]{0,180}',v['control_branch']) and '..' not in v['control_branch']
         and '//' not in v['control_branch'] and v['control_branch']!=v['branch'],'CONTROL_BRANCH')
    exact(v['limits'],LIMIT_KEYS)
    integer(v['limits']['acquisition_seconds'],1,MAX_ACQUISITION_SECONDS)
    integer(v['limits']['command_seconds'],1,MAX_COMMAND_SECONDS)
    integer(v['limits']['command_cpu_seconds'],1,MAX_COMMAND_CPU_SECONDS)
    integer(v['limits']['poll_seconds'],1,15)
    need(v['limits']['command_seconds']<=v['limits']['acquisition_seconds'],'CARRIER_TIME_RELATION')
    packet=base.parent
    exact(v['core_bodies'],BODY_NAMES)
    records={}
    for name,row in v['core_bodies'].items():
        body,record=F.read_file(packet/name,1024*1024)
        need(descriptor(body)==row,'CARRIER_CURRENT_CORE_BODY');records[name]=record
    exact(v['placement_body'],('path','bytes','sha256'))
    need(v['placement_body']['path']=='root_placement.py','CARRIER_FIXED_PLACEMENT_MODULE')
    placement_raw,placement_record=F.read_file(packet/'root_placement.py',1024*1024)
    need(dict(path='root_placement.py',**descriptor(placement_raw))==v['placement_body'],'CARRIER_PLACEMENT_BODY_PIN')
    index_raw,index_record=F.read_file(base/'INPUT_INDEX.json',MAX_INDEX)
    need(descriptor(index_raw)==v['input_index'],'CARRIER_INDEX_PIN')
    index=parse(index_raw,MAX_INDEX);C.check_index(index)
    for name,row in RETAINED.items():need(index.get(name)==row,'RETAINED_INPUT_PIN')
    need(set(RETAINED)|set(ROLES.values())<=set(index),'CARRIER_ALL_ROLE_BODIES_REQUIRED')
    admission_raw,admission_record=F.read_file(base/'CARRIER_ADMISSION.json',MAX_INDEX)
    need(descriptor(admission_raw)==v['carrier_admission'],'CARRIER_ADMISSION_BODY_PIN')
    admission=parse(admission_raw,MAX_INDEX)
    expected=dict(schema='dg16.core-private-carrier-root-admission.v2',issuer='R5_ROOT_GOVERNOR',
        operation='ONE_FIXED_TOOL_BOOTSTRAP_ONE_FRESH_RECIPIENT_ONE_PRIVATE_TRANSFER',source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,source_tree=SOURCE_TREE,
        workflow_branch=v['branch'],workflow_path=v['workflow_path'],workflow_sha256=v['workflow_sha256'],
        control_branch=v['control_branch'],control_parent=v['control_parent'],input_index_sha256=sha(index_raw),
        limits=v['limits'],host_tool_bootstrap=v['host_tools'],run_attempt=1,automatic_retry=False,core_or_native_effect_grant=False,original_awards=[])
    need(admission==expected,'CARRIER_SEPARATE_ADMISSION_SCOPE')
    import host_tools
    host_tools.declaration(v)
    for role in ('root_tools',):
        exact(v[role],('openssl','env'))
        for name,row in v[role].items():
            exact(row,('bytes','sha256'));integer(row['bytes'],1,32*1024**2);digest(row['sha256'])
    v['_packet']=packet;v['_base']=base;v['_index']=index;v['_opening_core']=records
    v['_binding_raw']=raw;v['_admission_raw']=admission_raw
    v['_opening_contract']=dict(binding=binding_record,index=index_record,admission=admission_record)
    v['_opening_placement']=placement_record
    return v

"""Same-host fixed-file observation, then separately received root adoption.

Observation performs ordinary file reads only. It cannot create a recipient or
run a command. The immutable declaration contains no executable tool pin and
is never accepted as a Commands authorization. Actual root adoption arrives
on its own fixed ref, distinct from the ciphertext protocol and workflow ref.
"""
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
import stat
import time
import zipfile
import carrier_policy as P
import carrier_io as F
import provider_reader as V

PROFILE='DEFERRED_SAME_HOST_FIXED_TOOLS_V1'
PATHS={'env':'/usr/bin/env','openssl':'/usr/bin/openssl'}
MAX_FILE=32*1024**2
MAX_BODY=65536
MAX_ARCHIVE=131072
MAX_PRIVATE_BYTES=4*1024**2
MAX_PRIVATE_ENTRIES=32
MAX_OBSERVATION_SECONDS=60
MAX_ADOPTION_SECONDS=600
_ANCHOR=None  # Installed only by the exact external entry, which pins the manifest.
OPERATIONS=('recipient','decrypt','prepare')
PHASES=('OPEN','PRE','POST','CLOSE')
FILES={'RESERVED.json':MAX_BODY,'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION.json':MAX_BODY,'SESSION.json':MAX_BODY,
 'OBSERVATION_OUTCOME.json':MAX_BODY,'ADOPTION_RESERVED.json':MAX_BODY,'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION.json':MAX_BODY,
 'ADOPTION_PROVIDER.json':P.MAX_METADATA,'READY.json':MAX_BODY,'ADOPTION_OUTCOME.json':MAX_BODY}
FILES.update({'CURRENT_'+o.upper()+'_'+p+'.json':MAX_BODY for o in OPERATIONS for p in PHASES})

def declaration(binding):
    v=binding['host_tools']
    P.exact(v,('profile','paths','control_branch','control_parent','observation_seconds','adoption_seconds'))
    P.need(v['profile']==PROFILE and v['paths']==PATHS,'HOST_TOOLS_DEFERRED_DECLARATION')
    P.need(type(v['control_branch']) is str and P.re.fullmatch(r'pro/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_-]{0,180}',v['control_branch'])
      and '..' not in v['control_branch'] and '//' not in v['control_branch']
      and v['control_branch'] not in (binding['branch'],binding['control_branch']),'HOST_TOOLS_SEPARATE_RESERVED_REF')
    P.need(type(v['control_parent']) is str and P.re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',v['control_parent'])
      and v['control_parent']!=binding['control_parent'],'HOST_TOOLS_SEPARATE_CONTROL_ANCESTRY')
    P.integer(v['observation_seconds'],1,MAX_OBSERVATION_SECONDS)
    P.integer(v['adoption_seconds'],1,MAX_ADOPTION_SECONDS)
    return v

def host_identity():
    body=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
    P.need(P.re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f-]{36}',body),'HOST_TOOL_BOOT_ID')
    P.need(os.getuid()==os.geteuid()==0,'HOST_TOOL_ACTUAL_ROOT_HOST_REQUIRED')
    return dict(uid=os.getuid(),euid=os.geteuid(),gid=os.getgid(),egid=os.getegid(),boot_id=body)

def anchor(binding,ctx):
    P.context(ctx);declaration(binding)
    P.need(callable(_ANCHOR),'HOST_TOOL_EXTERNAL_MANIFEST_ANCHOR_REQUIRED')
    value=_ANCHOR(binding,ctx)
    P.exact(value,('public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256'))
    for pin in value.values():P.digest(pin)
    return value

def directory(binding,ctx):return binding['_packet'].parent/('dg16-host-tools-'+ctx['run_id']+'-a1')

def census(path):
    info=path.lstat()
    P.need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_uid==os.geteuid()
      and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700 and not os.listxattr(path),'HOST_TOOL_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
    rows={}
    for entry in sorted(path.iterdir()):
        P.need(entry.name in FILES,'HOST_TOOL_UNKNOWN_MEMBER')
        _,rows[entry.name]=F.read_file(entry,FILES[entry.name],private=True)
    P.need(len(rows)+1<=MAX_PRIVATE_ENTRIES and sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values())<=MAX_PRIVATE_BYTES,
      'HOST_TOOL_ACTUAL_ALLOCATION_BOUND')
    return rows

def save(path,name,raw,*,terminal=False):
    P.need(name in FILES and type(raw) is bytes and len(raw)<=FILES[name],'HOST_TOOL_RECORD_SCOPE')
    rows=census(path)
    P.need(name not in rows and len(rows)+2+(0 if terminal else 2)<=MAX_PRIVATE_ENTRIES
      and sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values())+len(raw)+(0 if terminal else 2*MAX_BODY)<=MAX_PRIVATE_BYTES,
      'HOST_TOOL_PROSPECTIVE_ALLOCATION')
    return F.write_once(path/name,raw,FILES[name])

def tools_now():
    result={}
    for name,file in PATHS.items():
        raw,row=F.read_file(Path(file),MAX_FILE)
        info=Path(file).lstat()
        P.need(info.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)&0o022==0 and os.access(file,os.X_OK)
          and all(x[4]==0 and x[3]&0o022==0 for x in row['ancestors']),'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_FILE_CUSTODY')
        result[name]=dict(path=file,descriptor=P.descriptor(raw),physical=row)
    return result

def _terminal(status,ctx,observation_sha256,adoption_sha256=None):
    return dict(schema='dg16.host-tool-phase-outcome.v1',authority='NONE',status=status,context=ctx,
      observation_sha256=observation_sha256,adoption_sha256=adoption_sha256,
      command_executed=False,crypto_capability_claim=False,original_awards=[])

def observe(binding,ctx):
    """Closed read-only phase; no Commands import, process or tool execution."""
    declared=declaration(binding);opening_anchor=anchor(binding,ctx);host=host_identity()
    path=directory(binding,ctx);fd,identity=F.private_directory(path);os.close(fd)
    started=time.monotonic();issued=int(time.time()*1000);nonce=secrets.token_hex(32)
    reservation=dict(context=ctx,nonce=nonce,carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),
      issued_unix_ms=issued,operation='READ_ONLY_FIXED_ENV_AND_OPENSSL_BODIES')
    save(path,'RESERVED.json',P.encode(reservation))
    try:
        observed=tools_now()
        P.need(time.monotonic()<started+declared['observation_seconds'] and tools_now()==observed
          and host_identity()==host and anchor(binding,ctx)==opening_anchor,'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION_CLOSING')
        ancestry=F.parents(path/'marker');observed_at=time.monotonic()
        P.need(observed_at<started+declared['observation_seconds'],'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION_DEADLINE')
        value=dict(schema='dg16.same-host-fixed-tool-observation.v1',authority='NONE',phase='READ_ONLY_FIXED_TOOL_BODIES',
          context=ctx,source_commit=binding['source_commit'],source_tree=binding['source_tree'],
          carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),input_index_sha256=P.C.check_index(binding['_index']),
          **opening_anchor,host_identity=host,directory_identity=identity,nonce=nonce,issued_unix_ms=issued,
          tools=observed,observation_elapsed_ns=max(0,int((observed_at-started)*10**9)),
          command_executed=False,crypto_capability_claim=False,original_awards=[])
        raw=P.encode(value);observation=save(path,'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION.json',raw)
        session=dict(schema='dg16.same-host-tool-bootstrap-session.v1',context=ctx,host_identity=host,
          directory_identity=identity,directory_ancestry=ancestry,nonce=nonce,observation=observation,
          started_monotonic=started,adoption_deadline_monotonic=started+declared['observation_seconds']+declared['adoption_seconds'],
          latest_command_unix_ms=issued+(declared['observation_seconds']+declared['adoption_seconds']+binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds'])*1000)
        save(path,'SESSION.json',P.encode(session))
        P.need(time.monotonic()<started+declared['observation_seconds'],'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION_DEADLINE')
        outcome=_terminal('OBSERVED',ctx,P.sha(raw))
        save(path,'OBSERVATION_OUTCOME.json',P.encode(outcome),terminal=True)
        return dict(files={'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION.json':raw},result=outcome)
    except BaseException:
        outcome=_terminal('REFUSED',ctx,None)
        if not (path/'OBSERVATION_OUTCOME.json').exists():save(path,'OBSERVATION_OUTCOME.json',P.encode(outcome),terminal=True)
        raise

def observation_current(binding,ctx):
    path=directory(binding,ctx);rows=census(path)
    s=P.parse(F.read_file(path/'SESSION.json',MAX_BODY,private=True)[0],MAX_BODY)
    P.exact(s,('schema','context','host_identity','directory_identity','directory_ancestry','nonce','observation',
      'started_monotonic','adoption_deadline_monotonic','latest_command_unix_ms'))
    raw,row=F.read_file(path/'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION.json',MAX_BODY,private=True);v=P.parse(raw,MAX_BODY)
    P.need(s['schema']=='dg16.same-host-tool-bootstrap-session.v1' and s['context']==ctx
      and s['host_identity']==host_identity() and s['directory_identity']==F.directory_id(path.lstat())
      and s['directory_ancestry']==F.parents(path/'marker') and s['observation']==row
      and s['nonce']==v['nonce'],'HOST_TOOL_SAME_SESSION')
    expected=_terminal('OBSERVED',ctx,P.sha(raw))
    P.need(P.parse(F.read_file(path/'OBSERVATION_OUTCOME.json',MAX_BODY,private=True)[0],MAX_BODY)==expected,
      'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION_TERMINAL_JOIN')
    P.exact(v,('schema','authority','phase','context','source_commit','source_tree','carrier_binding_sha256',
      'input_index_sha256','public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256','host_identity','directory_identity',
      'nonce','issued_unix_ms','tools','observation_elapsed_ns','command_executed','crypto_capability_claim','original_awards'))
    expected_anchor=anchor(binding,ctx)
    P.need(v['schema']=='dg16.same-host-fixed-tool-observation.v1' and v['authority']=='NONE'
      and v['phase']=='READ_ONLY_FIXED_TOOL_BODIES' and v['context']==ctx
      and v['source_commit']==binding['source_commit'] and v['source_tree']==binding['source_tree']
      and v['carrier_binding_sha256']==P.sha(binding['_binding_raw'])
      and v['input_index_sha256']==P.C.check_index(binding['_index'])
      and all(v[k]==expected_anchor[k] for k in expected_anchor) and v['host_identity']==host_identity()
      and v['directory_identity']==s['directory_identity'] and v['command_executed'] is False
      and v['crypto_capability_claim'] is False and v['original_awards']==[] and tools_now()==v['tools'],
      'HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION_CURRENT_BODY')
    declared=declaration(binding);P.digest(v['nonce']);P.integer(v['issued_unix_ms'],0,int(time.time()*1000))
    P.integer(v['observation_elapsed_ns'],0,declared['observation_seconds']*10**9)
    P.need(s['adoption_deadline_monotonic']==s['started_monotonic']+declared['observation_seconds']+declared['adoption_seconds']
      and s['latest_command_unix_ms']==v['issued_unix_ms']+(declared['observation_seconds']+declared['adoption_seconds']+
        binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds'])*1000,'HOST_TOOL_FIXED_TIME_SCOPE')
    return path,s,raw,v,rows

def validate_adoption(raw,observation_raw,binding,now_ms):
    observation=P.parse(observation_raw,MAX_BODY);v=P.parse(raw,MAX_BODY)
    keys=('schema','issuer','operation','context','source_commit','source_tree','carrier_binding_sha256','input_index_sha256',
      'public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256','observation','nonce','host_identity','tools','issued_unix_ms',
      'expires_unix_ms','command_scope','automatic_retry','crypto_capability_claim','core_or_native_effect_grant','original_awards')
    P.exact(v,keys)
    wanted=dict(schema='dg16.same-host-fixed-tool-root-adoption.v1',issuer='R5_ROOT_GOVERNOR',
      operation='ADOPT_FIXED_SAME_HOST_TOOL_BODIES',observation=P.descriptor(observation_raw),
      command_scope=['recipient','decrypt'],automatic_retry=False,crypto_capability_claim=False,
      core_or_native_effect_grant=False,original_awards=[])
    for key in ('context','source_commit','source_tree','carrier_binding_sha256','input_index_sha256',
      'public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256','nonce','host_identity','tools'):wanted[key]=observation[key]
    wanted.update(issued_unix_ms=v['issued_unix_ms'],expires_unix_ms=v['expires_unix_ms'])
    P.need(P.encode(v)==P.encode(wanted),'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION_EXACT_JOIN')
    declared=declaration(binding)
    P.integer(v['issued_unix_ms'],observation['issued_unix_ms'],now_ms)
    P.integer(v['expires_unix_ms'],now_ms+1,observation['issued_unix_ms']+
      (declared['observation_seconds']+declared['adoption_seconds']+binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds'])*1000)
    return v

def check_control(provider,body,binding):
    P.exact(provider,('ref','commit','tree','blob','closing_ref'))
    d=declaration(binding);r=provider['ref'];c=provider['commit'];t=provider['tree']
    P.need(r==provider['closing_ref'] and r.get('ref')=='refs/heads/'+d['control_branch']
      and r.get('object',{}).get('type')=='commit' and r['object']['sha']==c.get('sha')
      and c['sha']!=d['control_parent'] and type(c.get('parents')) is list and len(c['parents'])==1
      and c['parents'][0].get('sha')==d['control_parent'],
      'HOST_TOOL_CONTROL_FRESH_PARENT')
    P.need(c.get('tree',{}).get('sha')==t.get('sha') and t.get('truncated') is False
      and type(t.get('tree')) is list and len(t['tree'])==1,'HOST_TOOL_CONTROL_TREE')
    row=t['tree'][0]
    P.need(row.get('path')=='HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION.json' and row.get('mode')=='100644' and row.get('type')=='blob'
      and row.get('size')==len(body) and row.get('sha')==provider['blob'].get('sha')
      and V.blob(provider['blob'],MAX_BODY)==body,'HOST_TOOL_CONTROL_BODY')
    return c['sha']

def api(binding,token,deadline):
    # A compile-bound separate ref; this cannot select the ciphertext reader.
    d=declaration(binding);copy=dict(binding,control_branch=d['control_branch'],control_parent=d['control_parent'])
    remaining=deadline-time.monotonic();P.need(remaining>0,'HOST_TOOL_PROVIDER_DEADLINE')
    copy['limits']=dict(binding['limits'],acquisition_seconds=max(1,math.ceil(remaining)))
    return V.GitHubReads(copy,token,deadline)

def receive_adoption(binding,ctx,token=None):
    path,s,observation_raw,observation,_=observation_current(binding,ctx)
    P.need(time.monotonic()<s['adoption_deadline_monotonic'],'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION_DEADLINE')
    save(path,'ADOPTION_RESERVED.json',P.encode(dict(context=ctx,observation=P.descriptor(observation_raw),nonce=observation['nonce'])))
    reader=api(binding,token,s['adoption_deadline_monotonic']);d=declaration(binding)
    try:
        while True:
            observation_current(binding,ctx);ref=reader.get('ref',d['control_branch'])
            P.need(ref.get('ref')=='refs/heads/'+d['control_branch'] and ref.get('object',{}).get('type')=='commit','HOST_TOOL_REF_SCOPE')
            if ref['object']['sha']!=d['control_parent']:break
            remaining=s['adoption_deadline_monotonic']-time.monotonic();P.need(remaining>0,'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION_DEADLINE')
            time.sleep(min(binding['limits']['poll_seconds'],remaining))
        commit=reader.get('commit',ref['object']['sha']);tree=reader.get('tree',commit.get('tree',{}).get('sha'))
        P.need(type(tree.get('tree')) is list and len(tree['tree'])==1,'HOST_TOOL_CONTROL_TREE')
        blob=reader.get('blob',tree['tree'][0].get('sha'));raw=V.blob(blob,MAX_BODY)
        provider=dict(ref=ref,commit=commit,tree=tree,blob=blob,closing_ref=reader.get('ref',d['control_branch']))
        selected=check_control(provider,raw,binding);adoption=validate_adoption(raw,observation_raw,binding,int(time.time()*1000))
        save(path,'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION.json',raw);save(path,'ADOPTION_PROVIDER.json',P.encode(provider))
        observation_current(binding,ctx)
        P.need(time.monotonic()<s['adoption_deadline_monotonic'],'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION_DEADLINE')
        ready=dict(schema='dg16.actual-same-host-tools-ready.v1',authority='NONE',context=ctx,observation=P.descriptor(observation_raw),
          adoption=P.descriptor(raw),control_commit=selected,nonce=observation['nonce'],retained=census(path),
          command_deadline_monotonic=min(s['adoption_deadline_monotonic']+binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds'],
            time.monotonic()+(adoption['expires_unix_ms']-int(time.time()*1000))/1000),
          original_awards=[])
        save(path,'READY.json',P.encode(ready));outcome=_terminal('ADOPTED',ctx,P.sha(observation_raw),P.sha(raw))
        save(path,'ADOPTION_OUTCOME.json',P.encode(outcome),terminal=True);return outcome
    except BaseException:
        outcome=_terminal('REFUSED',ctx,P.sha(observation_raw))
        if not (path/'ADOPTION_OUTCOME.json').exists():save(path,'ADOPTION_OUTCOME.json',P.encode(outcome),terminal=True)
        raise

def read_ready(binding,ctx):
    path,s,oraw,observation,rows=observation_current(binding,ctx)
    ready=P.parse(F.read_file(path/'READY.json',MAX_BODY,private=True)[0],MAX_BODY)
    P.exact(ready,('schema','authority','context','observation','adoption','control_commit','nonce','retained',
      'command_deadline_monotonic','original_awards'))
    raw,_=F.read_file(path/'HOST_TOOL_ADOPTION.json',MAX_BODY,private=True)

class ResolvedTools:

        reader=api(self.binding,self.token,self.deadline);d=declaration(self.binding)

          control_commit=self.value['ready']['control_commit'],provider_ref=ref,actual_reads=reader.audit,

def check_observation_artifact(archive,snapshot,context,binding,expected_anchor,now_ms,*,workflow_representation=V.RAW_API_WORKFLOW):
    """Body-backed mechanical receiving; root's actual tool history is separate.

    The return value is deliberately incapable of becoming a command pin or
    root adoption. The root must consume authentic provider responses and
    issue the separate exact adoption itself after this closed join succeeds.
    """
    P.need(type(archive) is bytes and 0<len(archive)<=MAX_ARCHIVE,'HOST_TOOL_ARTIFACT_BOUND')
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as z:
            rows=z.infolist();P.need(len(rows)==1 and rows[0].filename=='HOST_TOOL_OBSERVATION.json'
              and not rows[0].is_dir() and not rows[0].flag_bits&1 and rows[0].compress_type in (0,8)
              and 0<rows[0].file_size<=MAX_BODY and (rows[0].external_attr>>16)&0o170000 in (0,0o100000),
              'HOST_TOOL_ARTIFACT_POPULATION')
            raw=z.read(rows[0]);P.need(len(raw)==rows[0].file_size,'HOST_TOOL_ARTIFACT_BODY')
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile,RuntimeError,OSError) as exc:raise ValueError('HOST_TOOL_ARTIFACT_CRC') from exc
    v=P.parse(raw,MAX_BODY);P.context(context);P.exact(snapshot,('run','attempt','jobs','artifact','artifacts','workflow'))
    P.need(len(P.encode(snapshot))<=P.MAX_METADATA,'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_METADATA_AGGREGATE')
    P.exact(v,('schema','authority','phase','context','source_commit','source_tree','carrier_binding_sha256',
      'input_index_sha256','public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256','host_identity','directory_identity',
      'nonce','issued_unix_ms','tools','observation_elapsed_ns','command_executed','crypto_capability_claim','original_awards'))
    P.need(v['schema']=='dg16.same-host-fixed-tool-observation.v1' and v['authority']=='NONE' and v['original_awards']==[],
      'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_OBSERVATION_SCHEMA')
    P.digest(v['nonce']);P.integer(v['issued_unix_ms'],0,now_ms)
    P.integer(v['observation_elapsed_ns'],0,declaration(binding)['observation_seconds']*10**9)
    P.exact(v['host_identity'],('uid','euid','gid','egid','boot_id'))
    P.need(v['host_identity']['uid']==v['host_identity']['euid']==0
      and type(v['host_identity']['boot_id']) is str and P.re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f-]{36}',v['host_identity']['boot_id']),
      'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_HOST_IDENTITY')
    P.exact(v['tools'],('env','openssl'))
    for tool,file in PATHS.items():
        item=v['tools'][tool];P.exact(item,('path','descriptor','physical'));P.exact(item['descriptor'],('bytes','sha256'))
        P.integer(item['descriptor']['bytes'],1,MAX_FILE);P.digest(item['descriptor']['sha256'])
        physical=item['physical'];P.exact(physical,('bytes','sha256','identity','ancestors'))
        P.need(item['path']==file and {k:physical[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')}==item['descriptor']
          and type(physical['identity']) is list and len(physical['identity'])==9
          and all(type(n) is int and n>=0 for n in physical['identity'])
          and stat.S_ISREG(physical['identity'][2]) and physical['identity'][3]==1
          and physical['identity'][4]==item['descriptor']['bytes'] and physical['identity'][7]==0
          and physical['identity'][2]&0o022==0,'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_PHYSICAL_BODY')
        ancestors=physical['ancestors']
        P.need(type(ancestors) is list and len(ancestors)==3
          and all(type(r) is list and len(r)==6 and all(type(n) is int and n>=0 for n in r[1:]) for r in ancestors)
          and [r[0] for r in ancestors]==['/','/usr','/usr/bin']
          and all(stat.S_ISDIR(r[3]) and r[3]&0o022==0 and r[4]==0 for r in ancestors),
          'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_PHYSICAL_ANCESTRY')
    P.need(v.get('context')==context and v.get('source_commit')==binding['source_commit']
      and v.get('source_tree')==binding['source_tree'] and v.get('carrier_binding_sha256')==P.sha(binding['_binding_raw'])
      and v.get('input_index_sha256')==P.C.check_index(binding['_index'])
      and all(v.get(k)==expected_anchor[k] for k in ('public_manifest_sha256','bootstrap_admission_sha256'))
      and v.get('phase')=='READ_ONLY_FIXED_TOOL_BODIES' and v.get('command_executed') is False
      and v.get('crypto_capability_claim') is False,'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_ARTIFACT_BINDING')
    for name in ('run','attempt'):
        r=snapshot[name]
        P.need(r.get('id')==int(context['run_id']) and r.get('run_attempt')==1 and r.get('event')=='push'
          and r.get('status')=='in_progress' and r.get('head_branch')==context['branch']
          and r.get('head_sha')==context['workflow_commit'] and r.get('path')==context['workflow_path']
          and r.get('repository',{}).get('full_name')==P.REPOSITORY
          and r.get('head_repository',{}).get('full_name')==P.REPOSITORY
          and V.unix_ms(r.get('run_started_at'))<=v['issued_unix_ms'],'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_LIVE_RUN')
    repo=snapshot['run']['repository']['id'];P.integer(repo,1,10**20)
    P.need(all(snapshot[n][k].get('id')==repo for n in ('run','attempt') for k in ('repository','head_repository')),
      'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_REPOSITORY_ID')
    jobs=snapshot['jobs'];P.need(jobs.get('total_count')==1 and type(jobs.get('jobs')) is list and len(jobs['jobs'])==1,
      'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_SINGLE_JOB');job=jobs['jobs'][0]
    P.need(job.get('run_id')==int(context['run_id']) and job.get('run_attempt')==1 and job.get('head_sha')==context['workflow_commit']
      and job.get('name')==context['job_name'] and job.get('status')=='in_progress'
      and V.unix_ms(job.get('started_at'))<=v['issued_unix_ms'],'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_LIVE_JOB')
    a=snapshot['artifact'];r=a.get('workflow_run',{})
    P.need(a.get('name')=='dg16-core-host-tools-'+context['run_id']+'-a1' and a.get('expired') is False
      and a.get('size_in_bytes')==len(archive) and a.get('digest')=='sha256:'+P.sha(archive)
      and r.get('id')==int(context['run_id']) and r.get('head_sha')==context['workflow_commit']
      and r.get('head_branch')==context['branch'] and r.get('repository_id')==r.get('head_repository_id')==repo
      and v['issued_unix_ms']<=V.unix_ms(a.get('created_at'))<=now_ms,'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_ACTUAL_ARTIFACT')
    listing=snapshot['artifacts'];P.need(type(listing.get('artifacts')) is list and type(listing.get('total_count')) is int
      and listing['total_count']==len(listing['artifacts'])<=100
      and [r for r in listing['artifacts'] if r.get('name')==a['name']]==[a],'HOST_TOOL_ROOT_ARTIFACT_JOIN')
    V.workflow_body(snapshot['workflow'],context,binding['workflow_sha256'],representation=workflow_representation)
    return dict(schema='dg16.host-tool-mechanical-artifact-receiving.v1',authority='NONE',observation=P.descriptor(raw),
      artifact=P.descriptor(archive),artifact_id=a['id'],job_id=job['id'],context=context,
      authentic_root_tool_history_required=True,tool_adoption_issued=False,command_authority=False,original_awards=[])

_RECEIVED = object()

def json_body(raw):
    def pairs(rows):
        value={}
        for key,item in rows:P.need(key not in value,'PROVIDER_DUPLICATE_KEY');value[key]=item
        return value
    try:return json.loads(raw,object_pairs_hook=pairs,
        parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('PROVIDER_NONFINITE_JSON')))
    except (UnicodeError,json.JSONDecodeError,RecursionError) as exc:raise ValueError('PROVIDER_JSON_REFUSED') from exc

def blob(value,maximum):
    P.need(type(value) is dict and value.get('encoding')=='base64'
      and type(value.get('content')) is str and len(value['content'])<=maximum*2+65536,'PROVIDER_BLOB_SHAPE')
    try:raw=base64.b64decode(value['content'].replace('\n',''),validate=True)
    except (ValueError,TypeError) as exc:raise ValueError('PROVIDER_BLOB_ENCODING') from exc
    P.need(type(value.get('size')) is int and len(raw)==value['size']<=maximum,'PROVIDER_BLOB_BOUND')
    git=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode('ascii')+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()
    P.need(value.get('sha')==git,'PROVIDER_GIT_BLOB_CHANGED');return raw

def workflow_endpoint(ctx):
    P.context(ctx)
    return 'https://api.github.com/repos/'+P.REPOSITORY+'/contents/'+ctx['workflow_path']+'?ref='+ctx['workflow_commit']

def workflow_body(value,ctx,expected_sha256,*,representation=RAW_API_WORKFLOW):
    """Exact body joins, never provider authentication or a transport fallback.

    The supported-tool form is explicitly derived evidence. Its tool-result
    descriptor joins the unchanged result retained by the root dispatcher;
    this pure function cannot attest that those bytes were actually acquired.
    """
    P.context(ctx);P.digest(expected_sha256)
    if representation==RAW_API_WORKFLOW:
        raw=blob(value,65536)
        P.need(value.get('type')=='file' and value.get('path')==ctx['workflow_path']
          and P.sha(raw)==expected_sha256,'PROVIDER_ACTUAL_WORKFLOW_BODY')
        return raw
    P.need(representation==SUPPORTED_TOOL_WORKFLOW,'PROVIDER_WORKFLOW_REPRESENTATION')
    P.exact(value,('schema','representation','authority','endpoint','repository','path','commit','body_text','body',
      'derived_git_blob_sha1','actual_tool_result','authentication_boundary'))
    P.need(value['schema']=='dg16.supported-tool-workflow-text.v1' and value['representation']==SUPPORTED_TOOL_WORKFLOW
      and value['authority']=='NONE' and value['authentication_boundary']=='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED'
      and value['endpoint']==workflow_endpoint(ctx) and value['repository']==P.REPOSITORY
      and value['path']==ctx['workflow_path'] and value['commit']==ctx['workflow_commit'],
      'PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_CONTEXT')
    P.need(type(value['body_text']) is str,'PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_TEXT')
    try:raw=value['body_text'].encode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeError as exc:raise ValueError('PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_UTF8') from exc
    P.need(0<len(raw)<=65536,'PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_BOUND')
    for name,maximum in (('body',65536),('actual_tool_result',4*1024**2)):
        P.exact(value[name],('bytes','sha256'));P.integer(value[name]['bytes'],1,maximum);P.digest(value[name]['sha256'])
    git=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode('ascii')+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()
    P.need(value['body']==P.descriptor(raw) and P.sha(raw)==expected_sha256
      and value['derived_git_blob_sha1']==git,'PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_BODY')
    return raw

def supported_workflow(body,actual_tool_result,ctx,expected_sha256):
    """Called only after the broker checks the complete actual tool envelope.

    No GitHub API envelope, encoding, size, or provider-reported Git SHA is
    synthesized. The Git object ID here is explicitly computed from the body.
    """
    P.need(type(body) is bytes and type(actual_tool_result) is bytes,'PROVIDER_SUPPORTED_WORKFLOW_BYTES')
    value=dict(schema='dg16.supported-tool-workflow-text.v1',representation=SUPPORTED_TOOL_WORKFLOW,authority='NONE',
      endpoint=workflow_endpoint(ctx),repository=ctx['repository'],path=ctx['workflow_path'],commit=ctx['workflow_commit'],
      body_text=body.decode('utf-8'),body=P.descriptor(body),
      derived_git_blob_sha1=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(body)).encode('ascii')+b'\0'+body).hexdigest(),
      actual_tool_result=P.descriptor(actual_tool_result),authentication_boundary='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED')
    workflow_body(value,ctx,expected_sha256,representation=SUPPORTED_TOOL_WORKFLOW)
    return value

def artifact_files(raw):
    P.need(type(raw) is bytes and 0<len(raw)<=P.MAX_ARTIFACT,'REQUEST_ARTIFACT_BOUND')
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
            infos=z.infolist()
            P.need(len(infos)==2 and {i.filename for i in infos}=={'REQUEST.json','RECIPIENT.pem'},'REQUEST_ARTIFACT_POPULATION')
            result={}
            for row in infos:
                maximum=P.MAX_REQUEST if row.filename=='REQUEST.json' else P.MAX_CERTIFICATE
                mode=(row.external_attr>>16)&0o170000
                P.need(not row.is_dir() and row.file_size<=maximum and row.file_size>0
                  and mode in (0,0o100000) and not row.flag_bits&1
                  and row.compress_type in (zipfile.ZIP_STORED,zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED),'REQUEST_ARTIFACT_MEMBER')
                value=z.read(row) # Exact known member; CRC checked, no extraction.
                P.need(len(value)==row.file_size,'REQUEST_ARTIFACT_BODY');result[row.filename]=value
            return result
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile,RuntimeError,OSError) as exc:raise ValueError('REQUEST_ARTIFACT_CRC_OR_FORMAT') from exc

def unix_ms(value):
    P.need(type(value) is str and len(value)<=40,'PROVIDER_TIME')
    try:
        parsed=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
        P.need(parsed.tzinfo is not None,'PROVIDER_TIME')
        return int(parsed.timestamp()*1000)
    except (ValueError,OverflowError) as exc:raise ValueError('PROVIDER_TIME') from exc

def check_snapshot(snapshot,archive,ctx,index,workflow_sha256,now_ms,*,workflow_representation=RAW_API_WORKFLOW):
    """Mechanical joins only. This pure function does not confer provenance."""
    P.context(ctx)
    P.exact(snapshot,('run','attempt','jobs','artifact','artifacts','workflow'))
    P.need(len(P.encode(snapshot))<=P.MAX_METADATA,'PROVIDER_SNAPSHOT_AGGREGATE_BOUND')
    files=artifact_files(archive)
    q=P.validate_request(files['REQUEST.json'],files['RECIPIENT.pem'],ctx,index,now_ms)
    for name in ('run','attempt'):
        row=snapshot[name]
        P.need(row.get('id')==int(ctx['run_id']) and row.get('run_attempt')==1
          and row.get('event')=='push' and row.get('status')=='in_progress'
          and row.get('head_branch')==ctx['branch'] and row.get('head_sha')==ctx['workflow_commit']
          and row.get('path')==ctx['workflow_path'] and row.get('repository',{}).get('full_name')==P.REPOSITORY
          and row.get('head_repository',{}).get('full_name')==P.REPOSITORY,'PROVIDER_RUN_BINDING')
        P.need(unix_ms(row.get('run_started_at'))<=q['issued_unix_ms'],'PROVIDER_RUN_CHRONOLOGY')
    repo_id=snapshot['run']['repository'].get('id')
    P.integer(repo_id,1,10**20)
    P.need(snapshot['run']['head_repository'].get('id')==repo_id
      and snapshot['attempt']['repository'].get('id')==repo_id
      and snapshot['attempt']['head_repository'].get('id')==repo_id,'PROVIDER_REPOSITORY_ID')
    jobs=snapshot['jobs']
    P.need(jobs.get('total_count')==1 and type(jobs.get('jobs')) is list and len(jobs['jobs'])==1,'PROVIDER_SINGLE_JOB')
    job=jobs['jobs'][0]
    P.need(job.get('run_id')==int(ctx['run_id']) and job.get('run_attempt')==1
      and job.get('head_sha')==ctx['workflow_commit'] and job.get('name')==ctx['job_name']
      and job.get('status')=='in_progress' and unix_ms(job.get('started_at'))<=q['issued_unix_ms'],'PROVIDER_JOB_BINDING')
    P.integer(job.get('id'),1,10**20)
    artifact=snapshot['artifact'];related=artifact.get('workflow_run',{})
    P.need(artifact.get('name')=='dg16-core-private-recipient-'+ctx['run_id']+'-a1'
      and artifact.get('expired') is False and artifact.get('size_in_bytes')==len(archive)
      and artifact.get('digest')=='sha256:'+P.sha(archive),'PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_DIGEST')
    P.need(related.get('id')==int(ctx['run_id']) and related.get('head_sha')==ctx['workflow_commit']
      and related.get('head_branch')==ctx['branch'] and related.get('repository_id')==repo_id
      and related.get('head_repository_id')==repo_id,'PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_RUN')
    P.need(q['issued_unix_ms']<=unix_ms(artifact.get('created_at'))<=now_ms,'PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_CHRONOLOGY')
    listing=snapshot['artifacts']
    P.need(type(listing.get('artifacts')) is list and type(listing.get('total_count')) is int
      and listing['total_count']==len(listing['artifacts'])<=100,'PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_LIST_BOUND')
    candidates=[row for row in listing['artifacts'] if row.get('name')==artifact['name']]
    P.need(len(candidates)==1 and candidates[0]==artifact,'PROVIDER_ARTIFACT_EXACT_JOIN')
    P.integer(artifact.get('id'),1,10**20)
    workflow_raw=workflow_body(snapshot['workflow'],ctx,workflow_sha256,representation=workflow_representation)
    return dict(authority='NONE',request=q,request_raw=files['REQUEST.json'],certificate=files['RECIPIENT.pem'],
       archive_sha256=P.sha(archive),artifact_id=artifact['id'],job_id=job['id'],repository_id=repo_id,
       workflow_body_sha256=P.sha(workflow_raw))

def check_control(ref,commit,tree,blobs,branch,parent):
    P.need(ref.get('ref')=='refs/heads/'+branch and ref.get('object',{}).get('type')=='commit'
      and ref['object']['sha']==commit.get('sha') and commit['sha']!=parent,'CONTROL_REF_BINDING')
    P.need(type(commit.get('parents')) is list and len(commit['parents'])==1
      and commit['parents'][0].get('sha')==parent,'CONTROL_ONE_FRESH_COMMIT')
    P.need(commit.get('tree',{}).get('sha')==tree.get('sha') and tree.get('truncated') is False
      and type(tree.get('tree')) is list and len(tree['tree'])==2,'CONTROL_TREE_BINDING')
    entries=tree['tree'];P.need({r.get('path') for r in entries}=={'CONTROL.json','INPUTS.cms'},'CONTROL_TREE_POPULATION')
    result={}
    for row in entries:
        name=row['path'];maximum=P.MAX_CONTROL if name=='CONTROL.json' else P.MAX_CIPHERTEXT
        P.need(row.get('mode')=='100644' and row.get('type')=='blob','CONTROL_TREE_MEMBER')
        raw=blob(blobs.get(row.get('sha')),maximum)
        P.need(blobs[row['sha']]['sha']==row['sha'] and row.get('size')==len(raw),'CONTROL_TREE_BLOB_BINDING')
        result[name]=raw
    return result

class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self,*args,**kwargs):raise ValueError('PROVIDER_REDIRECT_REFUSED')

class GitHubReads:
    """No caller-selected origin, URL, HTTP method, proxy or publication."""
    def __init__(self,binding,token,deadline):
        P.need(token is None or (type(token) is str and 0<len(token)<=4096 and '\n' not in token and '\r' not in token),'PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_SHAPE')
        self.binding=binding;self.token=token;self.deadline=deadline;self.audit=[]
        self.limit=math.ceil(binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds']/binding['limits']['poll_seconds'])*2+64
        self.opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),
           urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl.create_default_context()),_NoRedirect())
    def get(self,kind,identifier):
        P.need(time.monotonic()<self.deadline and len(self.audit)<self.limit,'PROVIDER_ACQUISITION_BOUND')
        prefix='/repos/'+P.REPOSITORY
        if kind in ('run','attempt','jobs','artifacts','artifact'):
            P.need(type(identifier) is str and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]{0,19}',identifier),'PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER')
            suffix={'run':'/actions/runs/'+identifier,'attempt':'/actions/runs/'+identifier+'/attempts/1',
              'jobs':'/actions/runs/'+identifier+'/attempts/1/jobs?per_page=100&page=1',
              'artifacts':'/actions/runs/'+identifier+'/artifacts?per_page=100&page=1',
              'artifact':'/actions/artifacts/'+identifier}[kind]

def close_plan(visible,kept,error_fd):
    P.need(type(visible) is list and len(visible)<=FD_LIMIT and len(visible)==len(set(visible))
      and all(type(fd) is int and 0<=fd<2**31 for fd in visible),'SENDER_DESCRIPTOR_POPULATION')
    P.need(len(kept)==3 and error_fd not in kept,'SENDER_ERROR_FD_ALIAS')
    return [fd for fd in visible if fd>2 and fd not in kept and fd!=error_fd]

def append_stream(prefix,chunk):
    P.need(type(prefix) is bytes and type(chunk) is bytes and len(prefix)<=STREAM_MAX,'SENDER_STREAM_SHAPE')
    remaining=STREAM_MAX-len(prefix)
    return prefix+chunk[:remaining],len(chunk)>remaining

def descriptor_snapshot():
    rows=[]
    with os.scandir('/proc/self/fd') as entries:
        names=[]
        for entry in entries:
            P.need(entry.name.isdigit() and len(names)<FD_LIMIT,'SENDER_DESCRIPTOR_POPULATION')
            names.append(int(entry.name))
    for fd in sorted(names):
        try:s=os.fstat(fd)
        except OSError as exc:
            if exc.errno==errno.EBADF:continue  # The closed directory iterator only.
            raise
        flags=fcntl.fcntl(fd,fcntl.F_GETFD);status=fcntl.fcntl(fd,fcntl.F_GETFL)
        values=[fd,s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,flags,status]
        P.need(all(type(n) is int and 0<=n<2**64 for n in values),'SENDER_DESCRIPTOR_VALUE')
        rows.append(values)
    return rows

def kernel_echild():
    try:os.waitid(os.P_ALL,0,os.WEXITED|os.WNOHANG|os.WNOWAIT|0x40000000)
