PROVIDER_PROFILE='ROOT_SUPPORTED_GITHUB_FETCH_FILE_BROKER_V1'
HOST_CAPTURE_SHA256='429c6b50cef6ef6352a0c812ce9fcf386cc852156ba54c2d1419088c8f89f85c'

def load(binding,context,artifact_id,archive):
    base=Path(__file__).absolute().parent
    raw,row=F.read_file(base/'PRO_SENDER_COMPOSITION.json',P.MAX_INDEX)
    P.need(type(BINDING_SHA256) is str and P.sha(raw)==BINDING_SHA256,'PRO_SENDER_BINDING_REQUIRED')
    v=P.parse(raw,P.MAX_INDEX)
    P.need(v.get('state')=='REVIEWED_EXACT_PRO_SENDER','PRO_SENDER_UNRESOLVED')
    P.exact(v,('schema','state','source_commit','source_tree','capture_profile','provider_profile',
      'host_capture_sha256','operation','admission','original_awards'))
    P.need(v['schema']=='dg16.pro-private-sender-composition.v1' and v['source_commit']==binding['source_commit']
      and v['source_tree']==binding['source_tree'] and v['capture_profile']==CAPTURE_PROFILE
      and v['provider_profile']==PROVIDER_PROFILE and v['host_capture_sha256']==HOST_CAPTURE_SHA256
      and v['original_awards']==[],'PRO_SENDER_EXACT_ROLE_SCOPE')
    P.integer(binding['limits']['command_seconds'],4,P.MAX_COMMAND_SECONDS,'PRO_SENDER_CLOSING_INTERVAL_REQUIRED')
    bodies={};records={'composition':row}
    for name,file in (('operation','PRO_SENDER_OPERATION.json'),('admission','PRO_SENDER_ADMISSION.json')):
        body,physical=F.read_file(base/file,P.MAX_INDEX)
        P.need(P.descriptor(body)==v[name],'PRO_SENDER_ACTUAL_BODY_PIN')
        bodies[name]=body;records[name]=physical
    op=P.parse(bodies['operation'],P.MAX_INDEX)
    P.exact(op,('schema','context','source_commit','source_tree','carrier_binding_sha256','input_index_sha256',
      'artifact_id','artifact','nonce','issued_unix_ms','expires_unix_ms','sender_uid','sender_gid','original_awards'))
    P.context(context);P.digest(op['nonce']);P.integer(artifact_id,1,10**20)
    P.need(op['schema']=='dg16.pro-private-sender-operation.v1' and op['context']==context
      and op['source_commit']==binding['source_commit'] and op['source_tree']==binding['source_tree']
      and op['carrier_binding_sha256']==P.sha(binding['_binding_raw'])
      and op['input_index_sha256']==P.C.check_index(binding['_index']) and op['artifact_id']==artifact_id
      and op['artifact']==P.descriptor(archive) and op['original_awards']==[],'PRO_SENDER_OPERATION_BINDING')
    P.integer(op['issued_unix_ms'],0,10**16);P.integer(op['expires_unix_ms'],op['issued_unix_ms']+1,
      op['issued_unix_ms']+binding['limits']['acquisition_seconds']*1000)
    P.need(op['issued_unix_ms']<=int(time.time()*1000)<op['expires_unix_ms'],'PRO_SENDER_OPERATION_EXPIRED')
    P.need(type(op['sender_uid']) is int and op['sender_uid']>0 and os.getuid()==os.geteuid()==op['sender_uid']
      and type(op['sender_gid']) is int and os.getgid()==os.getegid()==op['sender_gid'],'PRO_SENDER_ACTUAL_NONROOT_IDENTITY')
    expected=dict(schema='dg16.pro-private-sender-root-admission.v1',issuer='R5_ROOT_GOVERNOR',
      operation_sha256=P.sha(bodies['operation']),capture_profile=CAPTURE_PROFILE,provider_profile=PROVIDER_PROFILE,
      source_commit=binding['source_commit'],source_tree=binding['source_tree'],
      carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),limits=binding['limits'],
      one_encryption=True,metadata_reads=18,automatic_retry=False,host_or_native_effect_grant=False,original_awards=[])
    P.need(P.parse(bodies['admission'],P.MAX_INDEX)==expected,'PRO_SENDER_ROOT_ADMISSION_SCOPE')
    return dict(value=v,operation=op,records=records,base=base,raw=raw)

def current(selection):
    for name,file in (('composition','PRO_SENDER_COMPOSITION.json'),('operation','PRO_SENDER_OPERATION.json'),
                      ('admission','PRO_SENDER_ADMISSION.json')):
        _,row=F.read_file(selection['base']/file,P.MAX_INDEX)
        P.need(row==selection['records'][name],'PRO_SENDER_CURRENT_BODY_CHANGED')
    op=selection['operation']
    P.need(op['issued_unix_ms']<=int(time.time()*1000)<op['expires_unix_ms']
      and os.getuid()==os.geteuid()==op['sender_uid'] and os.getgid()==os.getegid()==op['sender_gid'],
      'PRO_SENDER_CURRENT_OPERATION_CHANGED')
    return True

"""Eighteen fixed supported-tool reads over owned write-once files.

This module never performs a network/tool call. Only the explicitly reviewed
root dispatcher may execute a reserved plan with the supported GitHub tool.
The result bytes and tool history are the authentication boundary; fields in
these files never attest that a tool or an actor really produced them.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import time
import carrier_policy as P
import carrier_io as F
import provider_reader as V

PROFILE='ROOT_SUPPORTED_GITHUB_FETCH_FILE_BROKER_V1'
TOOL='mcp__codex_apps__github_fetch'
KINDS=('run','attempt','jobs','artifact','artifacts','workflow')
PHASES=('OPENING','PRE_ENCRYPTION','CLOSING')
PARTS=('REQUEST','REQUEST_READY','DISPATCH_INTENT','TOOL_RESULT','REPLY','REPLY_READY','JOIN')
MAX_BYTES=12*1024**2
MAX_ENTRIES=18*7+2
TOOL_MAX=4*1024**2
END_MAX=65536
LIMITS={'REQUEST':4096,'REQUEST_READY':0,'DISPATCH_INTENT':8192,'TOOL_RESULT':TOOL_MAX,
        'REPLY':8192,'REPLY_READY':0,'JOIN':8192}

def endpoint(context,artifact_id,kind):
    P.context(context);P.integer(artifact_id,1,10**20);P.need(kind in KINDS,'BROKER_FIXED_KIND')
    run=context['run_id'];prefix='https://api.github.com/repos/'+P.REPOSITORY
    paths={'run':'/actions/runs/'+run,'attempt':'/actions/runs/'+run+'/attempts/1',
      'jobs':'/actions/runs/'+run+'/attempts/1/jobs?per_page=100&page=1',
      'artifact':'/actions/artifacts/'+str(artifact_id),'artifacts':'/actions/runs/'+run+'/artifacts?per_page=100&page=1',
      'workflow':'/contents/'+context['workflow_path']+'?ref='+context['workflow_commit']}
    return prefix+paths[kind]

def name(ordinal,part):
    P.integer(ordinal,0,17);P.need(part in PARTS,'BROKER_FIXED_PART')
    return 'BROKER_%02d_%s'%(ordinal,part)

def allowed():
    result={'BROKER_START.json':END_MAX,'BROKER_END.json':END_MAX}
    result.update({name(i,p):LIMITS[p] for i in range(18) for p in PARTS})
    return result

def unwrap_tool_result(raw,url,*,kind,context=None,workflow_sha256=None):
    P.need(kind in KINDS,'BROKER_FIXED_KIND')
    if kind=='workflow':
        P.need(url==V.workflow_endpoint(context),'BROKER_WORKFLOW_ENDPOINT_CONTEXT')
        P.digest(workflow_sha256)
    P.need(type(raw) is bytes and 0<len(raw)<=TOOL_MAX,'BROKER_TOOL_RESULT_BOUND')
    value=V.json_body(raw)
    P.need(type(value) is dict and set(value)<= {'content','structuredContent','isError','_meta'}
      and value.get('isError') is False,'BROKER_TOOL_ERROR_OR_SHAPE')
    meta=value.get('_meta',{})
    P.need(type(meta) is dict and not any(meta.get(k) for k in ('truncated','isTruncated','partial','hasMore')),
      'BROKER_TOOL_TRUNCATION')
    sc=value.get('structuredContent')
    P.need(type(sc) is dict and set(sc)<= {'content','title','modified_date','url','display_url','display_title','structuredContent'}
      and sc.get('url')==url and sc.get('display_url')==url and type(sc.get('content')) is str,
      'BROKER_ACTUAL_TOOL_ENDPOINT')
    if 'structuredContent' in sc:
        inner=sc['structuredContent']
        P.need(type(inner) is dict and set(inner)<= {'title','content','display_url'}
          and inner.get('content')==sc['content'] and inner.get('display_url')==url,'BROKER_NESTED_RESULT_CHANGED')
    body=sc['content'].encode('utf-8')
    P.need(0<len(body)<=P.MAX_METADATA,'BROKER_PROVIDER_BODY_BOUND')
    if kind=='workflow':parsed=V.supported_workflow(body,raw,context,workflow_sha256)
    else:
        parsed=V.json_body(body);P.need(type(parsed) is dict,'BROKER_PROVIDER_BODY_SHAPE')
    return body,parsed

class Store:
    """Internal held-directory API; the external dispatcher derives its path."""
    def __init__(self,directory,binding,operation,deadline,*,budget=None,create=False):
        self.directory=Path(directory);self.binding=binding;self.op=operation;self.deadline=deadline;self.closed=False
        self.fd=os.open(self.directory,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_CLOEXEC|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            self.identity=F.directory_id(os.fstat(self.fd));self.ancestry=F.parents(self.directory/'marker')
            self._current()
            if create:
                P.need(budget is not None,'BROKER_PREALLOCATION_REQUIRED');budget.reserve(MAX_BYTES,MAX_ENTRIES)
                P.need(not any(p.name.startswith('BROKER_') for p in self.directory.iterdir()),'BROKER_FRESH_SESSION_REQUIRED')
                start=dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-start.v1',profile=PROFILE,context=operation['context'],
                  source_commit=binding['source_commit'],source_tree=binding['source_tree'],
                  carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),input_index_sha256=P.C.check_index(binding['_index']),
                  request_artifact=operation['artifact'],artifact_id=operation['artifact_id'],nonce=operation['nonce'],
                  operation_sha256=P.sha(P.encode(operation)),directory_identity=self.identity,deadline_monotonic=deadline,
                  max_bytes=MAX_BYTES,max_entries=MAX_ENTRIES,tool=TOOL,authority='NONE',original_awards=[])
                self.write('BROKER_START.json',P.encode(start),opening=True)
            start=self.read_json('BROKER_START.json');self.start=start
            P.need(start==dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-start.v1',profile=PROFILE,context=operation['context'],
              source_commit=binding['source_commit'],source_tree=binding['source_tree'],
              carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(binding['_binding_raw']),input_index_sha256=P.C.check_index(binding['_index']),
              request_artifact=operation['artifact'],artifact_id=operation['artifact_id'],nonce=operation['nonce'],
              operation_sha256=P.sha(P.encode(operation)),directory_identity=self.identity,deadline_monotonic=deadline,
              max_bytes=MAX_BYTES,max_entries=MAX_ENTRIES,tool=TOOL,authority='NONE',original_awards=[]),'BROKER_START_BINDING')
        except BaseException:
            os.close(self.fd);self.closed=True;raise
    def _current(self):
        P.need(not self.closed and F.directory_id(os.fstat(self.fd))==self.identity
          and F.directory_id(self.directory.lstat())==self.identity and not self.directory.is_symlink()
          and os.fstat(self.fd).st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(self.fd).st_mode)==0o700
          and not os.listxattr(self.fd) and F.parents(self.directory/'marker')==self.ancestry,'BROKER_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
    def census(self):
        self._current();result={};limits=allowed()
        for entry in sorted(self.directory.iterdir()):
            if not entry.name.startswith('BROKER_'):continue
            P.need(entry.name in limits,'BROKER_UNKNOWN_MEMBER')
            raw,row=F.read_file(entry,limits[entry.name],private=True)
            P.need(F.directory_id(self.directory.lstat())==self.identity,'BROKER_CENSUS_CHANGED')
            result[entry.name]=row
        P.need(len(result)<=MAX_ENTRIES and sum(r['bytes'] for r in result.values())<=MAX_BYTES,'BROKER_ALLOCATION_BOUND')
        return result
    def write(self,member,raw,*,opening=False,closing=False):
        self._current();P.need(member in allowed() and type(raw) is bytes and len(raw)<=allowed()[member],'BROKER_WRITE_SCOPE')
        rows=self.census();P.need('BROKER_END.json' not in rows,'BROKER_ALREADY_TERMINAL')
        P.need(member not in rows,'BROKER_WRITE_ONCE')
        P.need(sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values())+len(raw)+(0 if closing else END_MAX)<=MAX_BYTES
          and len(rows)+1+(0 if closing else 1)<=MAX_ENTRIES,'BROKER_PROSPECTIVE_ALLOCATION')
        P.need(opening or closing or time.monotonic()<self.deadline,'BROKER_DEADLINE')
        # Keep the directory FD open throughout the no-follow, exclusive write.
        fd=os.open(member,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600,dir_fd=self.fd)
        try:
            os.fchmod(fd,0o600)
            offset=0
            while offset<len(raw):
                n=os.write(fd,raw[offset:]);P.need(n>0,'BROKER_WRITE');offset+=n
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:os.close(fd)
        os.fsync(self.fd);observed,row=F.read_file(self.directory/member,allowed()[member],private=True)
        self._current();P.need(observed==raw,'BROKER_WRITE_READBACK');return row
    def read(self,member):
        self._current();P.need(member in allowed(),'BROKER_READ_SCOPE')
        raw,row=F.read_file(self.directory/member,allowed()[member],private=True);self._current();return raw,row
    def read_json(self,member):return P.parse(self.read(member)[0],allowed()[member])
    def marker_ready(self,ordinal,part):
        P.need(part in ('REQUEST_READY','REPLY_READY'),'BROKER_FIXED_READY_MARKER')
        self._current();member=name(ordinal,part)
        try:info=os.stat(member,dir_fd=self.fd,follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:return False
        P.need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink==1 and info.st_size==0
          and info.st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o600,'BROKER_READY_MARKER_CUSTODY')
        P.need(self.read(member)[0]==b'','BROKER_READY_MARKER_BODY');return True
    def request(self,ordinal):
        P.integer(ordinal,0,17)
        phase,kind=PHASES[ordinal//6],KINDS[ordinal%6]
        return dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-request.v1',profile=PROFILE,ordinal=ordinal,phase=phase,kind=kind,
          nonce=self.op['nonce'],operation_sha256=P.sha(P.encode(self.op)),context=self.op['context'],
          artifact_id=self.op['artifact_id'],source_commit=self.binding['source_commit'],source_tree=self.binding['source_tree'],
          carrier_binding_sha256=P.sha(self.binding['_binding_raw']),method='GET',tool=TOOL,
          arguments=dict(url=endpoint(self.op['context'],self.op['artifact_id'],kind)))
    def _request_body(self,ordinal):
        raw,row=self.read(name(ordinal,'REQUEST'));value=P.parse(raw,4096)
        P.need(value==self.request(ordinal) and self.read(name(ordinal,'REQUEST_READY'))[0]==b'',
          'BROKER_REQUEST_EXACT_BINDING')
        return value,row
    def inspect_request(self,ordinal):
        value,row=self._request_body(ordinal)
        for i in range(ordinal):self.joined(i)
        P.need(not any(name(i,'REQUEST') in self.census() for i in range(ordinal+1,18)),'BROKER_REQUEST_ORDER')
        return value,row
    def reserve_dispatch(self,ordinal):
        request,row=self.inspect_request(ordinal);rows=self.census()
        P.need(name(ordinal,'DISPATCH_INTENT') not in rows,'BROKER_UNCERTAIN_RESERVATION_NO_SECOND_FETCH')
        P.need(time.monotonic()<self.deadline,'BROKER_DEADLINE')
        # A maximum sized tool result and all remainder records must fit before GET.
        P.need(sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values())+TOOL_MAX+3*8192+END_MAX<=MAX_BYTES,'BROKER_DISPATCH_ALLOCATION')
        intent=dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-dispatch-intent.v1',ordinal=ordinal,nonce=self.op['nonce'],
          request=P.descriptor(P.encode(request)),tool=TOOL,arguments=request['arguments'],
          deadline_monotonic=min(self.deadline,time.monotonic()+self.binding['limits']['command_seconds']),
          automatic_retry=False,external_tool_history_required=True)
        pin=self.write(name(ordinal,'DISPATCH_INTENT'),P.encode(intent))
        return dict(tool=TOOL,arguments=request['arguments'],ordinal=ordinal,nonce=self.op['nonce'],
          intent_sha256=pin['sha256'],request_sha256=row['sha256'],deadline_monotonic=intent['deadline_monotonic'])
    def publish_response(self,ordinal,intent_sha256,actual_tool_result_raw,tool_call_ref):
        request,_=self.inspect_request(ordinal);iraw,_=self.read(name(ordinal,'DISPATCH_INTENT'));intent=P.parse(iraw,8192)
        P.need(P.sha(iraw)==intent_sha256 and intent['request']==P.descriptor(P.encode(request))
          and intent['tool']==TOOL and intent['arguments']==request['arguments'] and intent['nonce']==self.op['nonce']
          and intent['ordinal']==ordinal and intent['automatic_retry'] is False,'BROKER_DISPATCH_JOIN')
        P.need(type(tool_call_ref) is str and re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,160}',tool_call_ref),'BROKER_EXTERNAL_CALL_REFERENCE')
        P.need(type(actual_tool_result_raw) is bytes and 0<len(actual_tool_result_raw)<=TOOL_MAX,'BROKER_TOOL_RESULT_BOUND')
        rows=self.census()
        if name(ordinal,'REPLY_READY') in rows:
            reply=self.reply(ordinal)
            P.need(self.read(name(ordinal,'TOOL_RESULT'))[0]==actual_tool_result_raw
              and reply['tool_call_ref']==tool_call_ref,'BROKER_COMMITTED_RESPONSE_CHANGED')
            return dict(status='RECEIVED_EXISTING_COMMITTED_REPLY',reply=reply,fetch_permitted=False)
        P.need(name(ordinal,'TOOL_RESULT') not in rows and name(ordinal,'REPLY') not in rows,
          'BROKER_UNCERTAIN_PARTIAL_RESPONSE_NO_RETRY')
        self.write(name(ordinal,'TOOL_RESULT'),actual_tool_result_raw)
        reason=None;body=None
        try:body,_=unwrap_tool_result(actual_tool_result_raw,request['arguments']['url'],kind=request['kind'],
          context=self.op['context'],workflow_sha256=self.binding['workflow_sha256'])
        except (ValueError,UnicodeError):reason='TOOL_ERROR_TRUNCATION_OR_ENDPOINT_REFUSED'
        if time.monotonic()>=intent['deadline_monotonic']:reason='TOOL_DEADLINE_EXPIRED'
        reply=dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-reply.v1',ordinal=ordinal,nonce=self.op['nonce'],
          request_sha256=P.sha(P.encode(request)),intent_sha256=intent_sha256,tool_call_ref=tool_call_ref,
          tool_result=P.descriptor(actual_tool_result_raw),provider_body=P.descriptor(body) if body is not None else None,
          status='RECEIVED' if reason is None else 'REFUSED',refusal=reason,
          authentication_boundary='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED',authority='NONE')
        self.write(name(ordinal,'REPLY'),P.encode(reply));self.write(name(ordinal,'REPLY_READY'),b'')
        return dict(status='COMMITTED_REPLY',reply=reply,fetch_permitted=False)
    def reply(self,ordinal):
        request,_=self._request_body(ordinal);iraw,_=self.read(name(ordinal,'DISPATCH_INTENT'))
        raw,_=self.read(name(ordinal,'TOOL_RESULT'));r=self.read_json(name(ordinal,'REPLY'))
        P.exact(r,('schema','ordinal','nonce','request_sha256','intent_sha256','tool_call_ref','tool_result','provider_body',
          'status','refusal','authentication_boundary','authority'))
        P.need(r['schema']=='dg16.root-tool-broker-reply.v1' and r['ordinal']==ordinal and r['nonce']==self.op['nonce']
          and r['request_sha256']==P.sha(P.encode(request)) and r['intent_sha256']==P.sha(iraw)
          and r['tool_result']==P.descriptor(raw) and r['authority']=='NONE'
          and r['authentication_boundary']=='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED'
          and self.read(name(ordinal,'REPLY_READY'))[0]==b'','BROKER_REPLY_BODY_JOIN')
        if r['status']=='RECEIVED':
            body,_=unwrap_tool_result(raw,request['arguments']['url'],kind=request['kind'],
              context=self.op['context'],workflow_sha256=self.binding['workflow_sha256'])
            P.need(r['provider_body']==P.descriptor(body) and r['refusal'] is None,'BROKER_REPLY_PROVIDER_JOIN')
        else:P.need(r['status']=='REFUSED' and r['refusal'] in ('TOOL_ERROR_TRUNCATION_OR_ENDPOINT_REFUSED','TOOL_DEADLINE_EXPIRED'),
          'BROKER_REPLY_STATUS')
        return r
    def joined(self,ordinal):
        reply=self.reply(ordinal);join=self.read_json(name(ordinal,'JOIN'))
        P.need(join==dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-join.v1',ordinal=ordinal,nonce=self.op['nonce'],
          request_sha256=reply['request_sha256'],reply_sha256=P.sha(P.encode(reply)),tool_result=reply['tool_result'],
          provider_body=reply['provider_body'],status=reply['status'],authentication_boundary='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED'),
          'BROKER_CLIENT_JOIN_CHANGED')
        return join
    def finish(self,complete):
        rows=self.census();P.need('BROKER_END.json' not in rows,'BROKER_ALREADY_TERMINAL')
        sequence=['BROKER_START.json']+[name(i,p) for i in range(18) for p in PARTS]
        present=[n for n in sequence if n in rows]
        P.need(present==sequence[:len(present)] and set(present)==set(rows),'BROKER_EXACT_PARTIAL_POPULATION')
        if complete:
            P.need(set(rows)==set(sequence),'BROKER_INCOMPLETE_POPULATION')
            for i in range(18):P.need(self.joined(i)['status']=='RECEIVED','BROKER_REFUSED_JOIN')
        end=dict(schema='dg16.root-tool-broker-end.v1',authority='NONE',complete=complete,
          nonce=self.op['nonce'],prefix={n:dict(bytes=r['bytes'],sha256=r['sha256']) for n,r in rows.items()},
          prefix_bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows.values()),prefix_entries=len(rows),original_awards=[])
        self.write('BROKER_END.json',P.encode(end),closing=True);final=self.census()
        self._current();os.close(self.fd);self.closed=True
        return dict(complete=complete,members=final,bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in final.values()),entries=len(final),
          authority='NONE',authentication_boundary='ACTUAL_ROOT_TOOL_HISTORY_REQUIRED')
    def close_fd(self):
        if not self.closed:os.close(self.fd);self.closed=True

class Client:
    def __init__(self,store):self.store=store;self.audit=[];self.ordinal=0
    def get(self,kind,identifier):
        i=self.ordinal;P.integer(i,0,17);s=self.store;request=s.request(i)
        expected=s.op['context']['workflow_commit'] if kind=='workflow' else str(s.op['artifact_id']) if kind=='artifact' else s.op['context']['run_id']
        P.need(kind==KINDS[i%6] and identifier==expected,'BROKER_FIXED_READ_SCHEDULE')
        started=time.monotonic();s.write(name(i,'REQUEST'),P.encode(request));s.write(name(i,'REQUEST_READY'),b'')
        deadline=min(s.deadline,started+s.binding['limits']['command_seconds'])
        # Uncommitted TOOL_RESULT/REPLY files may be in the writer's hands.
        # Until the ready marker, observe only that fixed marker, not those bodies.
        while not s.marker_ready(i,'REPLY_READY'):
            remaining=deadline-time.monotonic();P.need(remaining>0,'BROKER_REPLY_DEADLINE')
            time.sleep(min(0.05,remaining))

"""Finite physical byte readers. No native, subprocess, network or authority API."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat


class Refusal(ValueError):
    pass


def need(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise Refusal(code)


def encode(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def parse(raw):
    def pairs(rows):
        result = {}
        for key, value in rows:
            need(key not in result, 'EVIDENCE_DUPLICATE_KEY')
            result[key] = value
        return result
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                      parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(Refusal('EVIDENCE_NONFINITE_JSON')))


def stamp(value):
    return [value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_nlink,
            value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns, value.st_uid, value.st_gid]


def safe_name(name):
    path = PurePosixPath(name)
    need(type(name) is str and 0 < len(name) <= 4096 and not path.is_absolute()
         and str(path) == name and '..' not in path.parts and '.' not in path.parts
         and len(path.parts) <= 40, 'EVIDENCE_MEMBER_NAME')
    return name


def ancestors(path):
    result = []
    for parent in reversed(Path(path).absolute().parents):
        value = parent.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) and not parent.is_symlink(), 'EVIDENCE_PARENT_ALIAS')
        result.append([str(parent), value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid])
    return result


def file_record(path, maximum, *, body=False, require_owner=True):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    parents = ancestors(path)
    before = path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1
         and (not require_owner or before.st_uid == os.geteuid()) and 0 <= before.st_size <= maximum,
         'EVIDENCE_ORDINARY_FILE_REQUIRED')
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    chunks = [] if body else None
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    count = 0
    try:
        need(stamp(os.fstat(fd)) == stamp(before) and not os.listxattr(fd), 'EVIDENCE_OPEN_CHANGED')
        while True:
            raw = os.read(fd, min(1024 * 1024, maximum - count + 1))
            if not raw:
                break
            count += len(raw)
            need(count <= maximum, 'EVIDENCE_FILE_BOUND')
            digest.update(raw)
            if body:
                chunks.append(raw)
        need(count == before.st_size and stamp(os.fstat(fd)) == stamp(before)
             and stamp(path.lstat()) == stamp(before) and ancestors(path) == parents,
             'EVIDENCE_CLOSING_CHANGED')
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    row = dict(bytes=count, sha256=digest.hexdigest(), mode=stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode),
               physical=stamp(before), ancestors=parents)
    return (row, b''.join(chunks)) if body else row


def read(path, maximum=4 * 1024**2):
    return file_record(path, maximum, body=True)[1]


def read_packet(path, maximum=4 * 1024**2):
    """Pinned reviewed checkout/data input, preserving its observed owner.

    The caller must enforce its exact expected digest. Private produced/raw
    evidence uses read(), which still requires the actual process owner.
    """
    return file_record(path, maximum, body=True, require_owner=False)[1]


def write_once(path, raw, maximum=4 * 1024**2):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and len(raw) <= maximum, 'EVIDENCE_WRITE_BOUND')
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
    try:
        offset = 0
        while offset < len(raw):
            offset += os.write(fd, raw[offset:])
        os.fsync(fd)
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o400)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    need(read(path, maximum) == raw, 'EVIDENCE_WRITE_READBACK')
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=sha(raw))


def census(root, *, file_bytes, total_bytes, entries, depth=40):
    """Complete physical population including empty directories, no exclusions."""
    root = Path(root).absolute()
    result = {'files': {}, 'directories': {}}
    total = 0
    for parent, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        here = Path(parent)
        info = here.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not here.is_symlink()
             and info.st_uid == os.geteuid(), 'EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY_CUSTODY')
        name = here.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        result['directories'][name] = [info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_uid, info.st_gid]
        need(len(here.relative_to(root).parts) <= depth, 'EVIDENCE_DEPTH_BOUND')
        for name in dirs:
            p = here / name
            need(not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISDIR(p.lstat().st_mode), 'EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY_ALIAS')
        for name in files:
            p = here / name
            key = safe_name(p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
            row = file_record(p, file_bytes)
            total += row['bytes']
            need(total <= total_bytes, 'EVIDENCE_TOTAL_BOUND')
            result['files'][key] = row
        need(len(result['files']) + len(result['directories']) <= entries, 'EVIDENCE_ENTRY_BOUND')
    result['total_bytes'] = total
    return result


def bind_bodies(root, members, *, maximum=16 * 1024**2, total=64 * 1024**2, require_owner=True):
    need(type(members) is dict and 0 < len(members) <= 4096, 'EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_POPULATION')
    result, count = {}, 0
    for name, expected in sorted(members.items()):
        safe_name(name)
        need(type(expected) is dict and set(expected) == {'bytes', 'sha256'}, 'EVIDENCE_DESCRIPTOR_SHAPE')
        need(type(expected['bytes']) is int and 0 <= expected['bytes'] <= maximum
             and type(expected['sha256']) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', expected['sha256']),
             'EVIDENCE_DESCRIPTOR_VALUE')
        row = file_record(Path(root) / name, maximum, require_owner=require_owner)
        need({k: row[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')} == expected, 'EVIDENCE_BODY_CHANGED')
        count += row['bytes']
        need(count <= total, 'EVIDENCE_TOTAL_BOUND')
        result[name] = row
    return result

    not make package bytes current on this host or supply a natural RLGWO event.
    """

    basis = scope_basis()[1]
    descriptors = basis['received_inputs']

        bodies[name] = raw

         and independent['no_new_original_awards'] == []
         and independent['retained_accepted_receipt']['sha256'] == sha(bodies['PACKAGE_TERMINAL_RECEIVING.json'])
         and terminal['disposition'] == 'ACCEPTED_SCOPED_CURRENT_PACKAGE_AND_INSTALLED_RUNTIME_RESULT'
         and terminal['source_commit'] == PACKAGE_COMMIT and terminal['source_tree'] == PACKAGE_TREE
         and terminal['new_original_awards'] == [], 'CURRENT_PACKAGE_INPUT_RECEIVING')
    expected = {row['role']:(row['bytes'], row['sha256'], row['member_bytes_modes_sha256']) for row in terminal['actual_packages']}

    raw = read_file(Path(api['private'])/'NATIVE_PREREQUISITE_RECEIVING.json',8192)

    return raw, value

def render_fences(run_root, values, initial):
    result = {}
    for name in DOCS:
        raw = read_file(run_root/name, CANONICAL_LIMIT)
        count = len(FENCE.findall(raw))
        need(count == (0 if initial else 1) and raw.count(b'```implementaudit-work-graph') == count,
             'CANONICAL_FENCE_POPULATION')
        fenced = b'```implementaudit-work-graph\n'+encode(values[name]).rstrip(b'\n')+b'\n```'
        result[name] = raw.rstrip(b'\n')+b'\n\n'+fenced+b'\n' if initial else FENCE.sub(lambda _: fenced, raw)
        need(len(result[name]) <= CANONICAL_LIMIT, 'CANONICAL_FILE_BOUND')
    need(sum(map(len, result.values())) <= CANONICAL_TOTAL, 'CANONICAL_TOTAL_BOUND')
    return result


def update_existing(path, before, after):
    # Keep each owner-created file and mode; never introduce a symlink, hardlink
    # or new canonical population. Currentness is deliberately invalidated first
    # for post-activation writes. Initialization has not activated yet.
    need(read_file(path, CANONICAL_LIMIT) == before, 'CANONICAL_PREIMAGE_CHANGED')
    old = path.lstat()
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        need(identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(old), 'CANONICAL_OPEN_CHANGED')
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb', closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(after)
            stream.truncate()
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    need(read_file(path, CANONICAL_LIMIT) == after and path.lstat().st_ino == old.st_ino
         and path.lstat().st_mode == old.st_mode, 'CANONICAL_READBACK')


@guarded
def author_checkpoint(api, diagnostic):
    source, private, run_root, run = context(api)
    diagnostic.phase('AUTHOR')
    need(api['receipt'] is None, 'PREACTIVATION_ONLY')
    scope_input_bodies(private/'g3-scope-inputs')
    docs = render_fences(run_root, declarations(run), True)
    before = {name: read_file(run_root/name, CANONICAL_LIMIT) for name in DOCS}
    write_once(private/'G3_INITIAL_CANONICAL.json', encode({name:sha(raw) for name,raw in before.items()}))
    for name in DOCS:
        update_existing(run_root/name, before[name], docs[name])
    diagnostic.done('AUTHORED')
    return dict(status='PREACTIVATION_NATIVE_DECLARATIONS_AUTHORED', source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,
                source_tree=SOURCE_TREE, original_awards=0)


def compiler_file(path):
    raw = read_file(path, COMPILER_BYTES)
    need(len(raw) == COMPILER_BYTES and sha(raw) == COMPILER_SHA, 'COMPILER_PIN')
    module = types.ModuleType('g3_exact_maintained_compiler')
    module.__file__ = str(path)
    exec(compile(raw, str(path), 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    need(read_file(path, COMPILER_BYTES) == raw, 'COMPILER_LOAD_CHANGED')
    return module


def compiler(source):
    return compiler_file(source/COMPILER)

    api['require_current']('g3-before-native-observation')
    # Nothing is retained/consumed until all maintained closing guards finish.
    with owner_module.observe_native_run_sources_v2(run_root, source, input_root=inputs) as raw:
        value = parse(raw)
        graph = value['projection']
        need(value['schema'] == 'implementaudit.native-run-source-observation.v2'
             and graph['binding']['acquisition'] == 'NATIVE_CONTINUITY_VERIFIED'
             and graph['binding']['candidate_head'] == SOURCE_COMMIT
             and graph['binding']['candidate_tree'] == SOURCE_TREE
             and graph['binding']['controller'] == api['controller']
             and graph['binding']['receipt'] == api['receipt'], 'ACTUAL_NATIVE_BINDING')
        need(graph['root'] == ROOT and graph['original_scope'] == ORIGINAL, 'ACTUAL_NATIVE_SCOPE')
    api['require_current']('g3-after-native-observation')
    return raw, graph


def check_selection(graph, dispatch, transition):
    need(dispatch['selected'] == SELECTED and dispatch['capacity'] == 2
         and dispatch['active_occupancy'] == 0 and dispatch['free_capacity'] == 2
         and dispatch['graph_required'] is True and dispatch['authority'] == 'NONE', 'PROSPECTIVE_SELECTION_DIFFERS')
    need(transition['selected'] == SELECTED and transition['ancestors'] == [PAIR,PHASE,ROOT]
         and transition['original_scope'] == ORIGINAL, 'RECURSIVE_SELECTION_DIFFERS')
    actual = {row['id']:row for row in graph['nodes']}
    expected = declarations('0')
    need(set(actual) == set(expected['STATE.md']['nodes']), 'WHOLE_ROOT_POPULATION')
    for name in ('DG17_INTERFACE_SCOPE','DG18_INTERFACE_SCOPE','FULL_G2_RECEIVING',
                 'DG16_ORIGINAL_RECEIVING','COMMON_ADOPTION_RECEIVING','RESERVED_SOURCE_ADOPTION','RESERVED_DG16_CERTIFICATION'):
        need(actual[name]['state'] == 'BLOCKED' and 'AUTHORIZATION' in actual[name]['blocked_reasons'],
             'LOCAL_SCOPE_OR_RESERVED_AUTHORITY_DROPPED')
    for name in ('DG17_INTERFACE_SCOPE','DG18_INTERFACE_SCOPE'):
        need(actual[name]['parent'] == ROOT and actual[name]['authority'] == ['scope:NOT_DELEGATED_TO_THIS_DG16_HOST']
             and 'scope:EXTERNAL_OWNER_REMAINS_INDEPENDENT' in actual[name]['reads'], 'EXTERNAL_OWNER_SCOPE_CHANGED')
    need(actual['COMMON_ADOPTION_RECEIVING']['requires'] == ['CURRENT_SOURCE_RECEIPT','CURRENT_PACKAGE_RECEIPT'],
         'WHOLE_SIBLING_BARRIER_FORBIDDEN')
    need(actual[JOIN]['requires'] == SELECTED and not actual[JOIN]['independent_results'], 'JOIN_DEPENDENCE_DECLARATION')
    need(not (set(actual[PAIR]['writes']) & set(actual[SCOPE]['writes'])), 'SHARED_WRITER_NOT_ADMITTED')

def adverse_basis():
    raw = read_file(Path(__file__).with_name('ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY.json'), 16384)
    need(sha(raw) == ADVERSE_SHA, 'ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY_PIN')
    value = parse(raw)
    need(value.get('schema') == 'dg16.g3-adverse-source-applicability.v1'
         and value.get('compiler_sha256') == COMPILER_SHA
         and value.get('source_commit') == SOURCE_COMMIT and value.get('source_tree') == SOURCE_TREE
         and value.get('status') == 'INERT_CONTROLS_PASSED_NATIVE_EXECUTION_UNPERFORMED'
         and value.get('native_operations') == 0 and value.get('original_awards') == 0,
         'ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY_SCOPE')
    return raw, value


@guarded
def prepare(api, diagnostic):
    source, private, run_root, run = context(api)
    diagnostic.phase('INPUTS')
    need(len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) >= 2, 'HOST_TASK_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE')
    need(callable(api.get('reacquire_inputs')), 'ACTUAL_COMPLETE_INPUT_CONSUMER_REQUIRED')
    observation, key = api['acquisition_observation'], digest(api['acquisition_key'])
    validate_source_acquisition(observation,key)
    scope_inputs = scope_input_bodies(private/'g3-scope-inputs')
    native_raw, _ = native_prerequisite(api)
    canonical_inputs = {}
    for name in ('STATE.md','PROTOCOL.md','ROADMAP.md','THINKING.md','sidecars.md','tools.md','context.md','phases/phase-1.md'):
        relative = api['run_root']+'/'+name
        captured = observation['provider']['source']['state']['files'].get(relative)
        current = read_file(run_root/name, CANONICAL_LIMIT)
        need(type(captured) is dict and captured['sha256'] == sha(current) and captured['bytes'] == len(current),
             'SELECTED_C5_CANONICAL_POPULATION')
        canonical_inputs[name] = dict(bytes=len(current),sha256=sha(current))
    base = private/'g3'
    base.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    inputs = base/'inputs'
    inputs.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    write_once(base/'SELECTED_CANONICAL_INPUTS.json', encode(canonical_inputs))
    initial = {'G1_INPUTS.json': encode(dict(key=key, observation=observation)),
               'POLICY.json': encode(policy(run)), 'ORIGINAL_SCOPE.json': scope_basis()[0],
               'SCOPE_READER.py': read_file(Path(__file__), 1024*1024),
               'COMPILER_READER.py': read_file(source/COMPILER, COMPILER_BYTES),
               'ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY.json': adverse_basis()[0],
               'NATIVE_PREREQUISITE_RECEIVING.json': native_raw, **scope_inputs}
    need(sum(map(len, initial.values())) <= TOTAL_LIMIT and len(initial) <= ENTRY_LIMIT, 'DECLARED_INPUT_AGGREGATE')
    for name, raw in initial.items():
        write_once(inputs/name, raw)
    diagnostic.phase('SELECT')
    engine = compiler(source)
    native_raw, graph = observe(api, engine, inputs)
    dispatch = engine.select_native_frontier_v1(graph)
    transition = engine.compile_recursive_transition_v1(graph, [])
    need(graph['binding']['epoch'] == 'G0001', 'INITIAL_NATIVE_GENERATION_REQUIRED')
    check_selection(graph, dispatch, transition)
    for name, data in (('SELECTED_NATIVE.json', native_raw), ('DISPATCH.json', encode(dispatch)),
                       ('TRANSITION.json', encode(transition))):
        write_once(base/name, data)
    diagnostic.done('SELECTED')
    diagnostic.phase('SCOPE_PROCESS')
    # This one real subprocess has its own finite output and joins before the
    # timed pair. It cannot modify canonical/source state or dispatch product.
    began = time.monotonic_ns()
    rc, out, err = api['command']('g3-host-scope-receiver', ['/usr/bin/python3.12', '-I', '-S', '-B',
        str(inputs/'SCOPE_READER.py'), '--scope-receive', str(base)], seconds=30)
    ended = time.monotonic_ns()
    need(rc == 0 and not err and len(out) <= PUBLIC_LIMIT, 'SCOPE_PROCESS_REFUSED')
    scope = validate_public_scope(out)
    need(scope['run_id'] == run and scope['graph_sha256'] == graph['digest']
         and scope['dispatch_sha256'] == dispatch['dispatch_id']
         and scope['complete_input_key'] == key, 'SCOPE_PROCESS_BINDING')
    write_once(base/'SCOPE_RETURN.json', out, PUBLIC_LIMIT)
    write_once(base/'SCOPE_EXECUTION.json', encode(dict(node=SCOPE, actual_exit_code=rc,
        began_monotonic_ns=began, ended_monotonic_ns=ended, stdout_sha256=sha(out), stderr_bytes=0,
        process_kind='ACTUAL_BOUNDED_DISTINCT_HOST_PROCESS', joined_before_timed_pair=True)))
    diagnostic.done('SCOPE_RETURNED')
    diagnostic.phase('INPUTS_RECHECK')
    again = api['reacquire_inputs']()
    need(type(again) is dict and set(again) == {'key', 'observation'}
         and again['key'] == key and again['observation'] == observation, 'COMPLETE_INPUTS_CHANGED')
    second_raw, second_graph = observe(api, engine, inputs)
    need(second_graph == graph, 'SELECTION_CHANGED_BEFORE_PAIR')
    write_once(base/'BEFORE_PAIR_NATIVE.json', second_raw)
    diagnostic.done('INPUTS_RECHECKED')
    return dict(status='PROSPECTIVE_TWO_CELL_SELECTION_COMPLETE', selected=SELECTED,
                graph_sha256=graph['digest'], dispatch_sha256=dispatch['dispatch_id'],
                acquisition_key=key, scope_output_sha256=sha(out), original_awards=0)


def scope_receive(base):
    """Distinct bounded preparation: reconcile current received inputs and the
    actual host selection against DG16 and its guarded external interfaces.
    This is useful component receiving, not RLGWO natural-transition evidence.
    """
    base = Path(base)
    graph = parse(read_file(base/'SELECTED_NATIVE.json'))['projection']
    dispatch = parse(read_file(base/'DISPATCH.json'))
    transition = parse(read_file(base/'TRANSITION.json'))
    inputs = base/'inputs'
    basis_raw = read_file(inputs/'ORIGINAL_SCOPE.json',8192)
    need(sha(basis_raw) == SCOPE_SHA, 'WORKER_ORIGINAL_SCOPE_PIN')
    basis = parse(basis_raw)
    p = parse(read_file(inputs/'POLICY.json',8192))
    acquired = parse(read_file(inputs/'G1_INPUTS.json'))
    need(p == policy(p['run_id']), 'WORKER_INPUT_BINDING')
    validate_source_acquisition(acquired['observation'],acquired['key'])
    current_inputs = scope_input_bodies(inputs)
    maintained = compiler_file(inputs/'COMPILER_READER.py')
    need(maintained.select_native_frontier_v1(graph) == dispatch
         and maintained.compile_recursive_transition_v1(graph,[]) == transition, 'WORKER_MAINTAINED_REDERIVATION')
    check_selection(graph,dispatch,transition)
    need(graph['binding']['acquisition'] == 'NATIVE_CONTINUITY_VERIFIED'
         and graph['binding']['candidate_head'] == SOURCE_COMMIT and graph['binding']['candidate_tree'] == SOURCE_TREE,
         'WORKER_ACTUAL_SOURCE_BINDING')
    actual = {x['id']:x for x in graph['nodes']}
    provider = acquired['observation']['provider']
    source_files = provider['source']['state']['files']
    need(type(source_files) is dict and provider['actual_source_files'] == len(source_files)
         and provider['actual_source_bytes'] == sum(row['bytes'] for row in source_files.values())
         and provider['source']['projection'] == 'ALL_ACTUAL_BYTES_NO_GIT_OR_HIDDEN_OMISSIONS', 'WORKER_ACTUAL_SOURCE_CENSUS')
    need(actual[SCOPE]['requires'] == ['CURRENT_SOURCE_RECEIPT','CURRENT_PACKAGE_RECEIPT']
         and actual['CURRENT_SOURCE_RECEIPT']['state'] == actual['CURRENT_PACKAGE_RECEIPT']['state'] == 'DONE'
         and actual['CURRENT_SOURCE_RECEIPT']['done_evidence'] == sha(current_inputs['SOURCE_ACQUISITION.json'])
         and actual['CURRENT_PACKAGE_RECEIPT']['done_evidence'] == sha(current_inputs['PACKAGE_ROOT_RECEIVING.json']),
         'WORKER_CURRENT_RECEIVED_INPUT_PREREQUISITE')
    adverse_raw, _ = adverse_basis()
    need(read_file(inputs/'ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY.json',16384) == adverse_raw, 'WORKER_ADVERSE_INPUT_CHANGED')
    required = (('DG16','DG16_ORIGINAL_RECEIVING','ACTIVE_TARGET_ORIGINAL_QUALIFICATION_REMAINS'),
                ('DG17','DG17_INTERFACE_SCOPE','INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_OWNER_CE057_INTERFACE_ONLY'),
                ('DG18','DG18_INTERFACE_SCOPE','INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_OWNER_CE051_CHANGED_INPUT_ONLY'))
    obligations = []
    for cell,consumer,condition in required:
        ids = basis['original_ids'][cell]
        need(len(ids) == basis['original_population'][cell] and len(ids) == len(set(ids))
             and actual[consumer]['state'] == 'BLOCKED', 'WORKER_ORIGINAL_CONSUMER_COVERAGE')
        obligations.append(dict(cell=cell,count=len(ids),original_ids_sha256=sha(encode(ids)),
            consumer=consumer,condition=condition,state='RETAINED_SCOPE_NOT_EXECUTED_BY_THIS_HOST'))
    need(sum(x['count'] for x in obligations) == 157 and len(graph['nodes']) == 14, 'WORKER_COMPLETE_POPULATION')
    value = dict(schema='dg16.g3-host-scope-receiving.v2',authority='NONE',source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,
        source_tree=SOURCE_TREE,run_id=p['run_id'],attempt=1,graph_sha256=graph['digest'],
        dispatch_sha256=dispatch['dispatch_id'],original_scope_sha256=SCOPE_SHA,
        complete_input_key=acquired['key'],selected_tracked_source_files=SOURCE_FILES,
        selected_tracked_source_bytes=SOURCE_BYTES,scope_obligations=obligations,
        actual_complete_source_files=provider['actual_source_files'],actual_complete_source_bytes=provider['actual_source_bytes'],
        ancestors=transition['ancestors'],selected=SELECTED,required_join=JOIN,root=ROOT,node_count=len(graph['nodes']),original_total=157,
        observed_affinity_count=len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),capacity_units=p['capacity_units'],host_capacity=2,operator_ceiling=2,
        reserve=0,active_owned_task_slots=0,independence=p['independence'],owner_arrangement=p['owner_arrangement'],
        received_input_bodies={name:sha(body) for name,body in current_inputs.items()},natural_transition=NATURAL_SCOPE,
        full_g2='NOT_DISPATCHED_OR_CONSUMED_IN_THIS_HOST',original_awards=0,
        future_adoption='SEPARATE_GUARDED_RECEIVING_AND_OWNER_DECISION',
        result='HOST_SPECIFIC_OBLIGATION_CLOSURE_RECEIVED',root_decision_before=BEFORE)
    return validate_public_scope(encode(value))


def validate_public_scope(raw):
    value = parse(raw,PUBLIC_LIMIT)
    exact(value,('schema','authority','source_commit','source_tree','run_id','attempt',
        'graph_sha256','dispatch_sha256','original_scope_sha256','complete_input_key',
        'selected_tracked_source_files','selected_tracked_source_bytes','scope_obligations','ancestors',
        'actual_complete_source_files','actual_complete_source_bytes','selected','required_join','root','node_count',
        'original_total','observed_affinity_count','capacity_units','host_capacity','operator_ceiling','reserve',
        'active_owned_task_slots','independence','owner_arrangement','received_input_bodies','natural_transition',
        'full_g2','original_awards','future_adoption','result','root_decision_before'))
    need(value['schema'] == 'dg16.g3-host-scope-receiving.v2' and value['authority'] == 'NONE'
         and value['source_commit'] == SOURCE_COMMIT and value['source_tree'] == SOURCE_TREE, 'PUBLIC_SCOPE_IDENTITY')
    need(type(value['run_id']) is str and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]{5,19}',value['run_id'])
         and type(value['attempt']) is int and value['attempt'] == 1, 'PUBLIC_SCOPE_RUN')
    for key in ('graph_sha256','dispatch_sha256','complete_input_key'): digest(value[key])
    need(value['original_scope_sha256'] == SCOPE_SHA and value['selected_tracked_source_files'] == SOURCE_FILES
         and value['selected_tracked_source_bytes'] == SOURCE_BYTES and value['original_total'] == 157
         and value['node_count'] == 14, 'PUBLIC_SCOPE_POPULATION')
    integer(value['observed_affinity_count'],2,4096)
    integer(value['actual_complete_source_files'],SOURCE_FILES,4096)
    integer(value['actual_complete_source_bytes'],SOURCE_BYTES,256*1024**2)
    expected = policy(value['run_id'])
    for key in ('capacity_units','host_capacity','operator_ceiling','reserve','active_owned_task_slots','independence','owner_arrangement'):
        need(type(value[key]) is type(expected[key]) and value[key] == expected[key], 'PUBLIC_SCOPE_POLICY')
    basis = scope_basis()[1]
    need(value['received_input_bodies'] == {name:row['sha256'] for name,row in basis['received_inputs'].items()}
         and value['natural_transition'] == NATURAL_SCOPE, 'PUBLIC_CURRENT_INPUT_SCOPE')
    need(value['selected'] == SELECTED and value['ancestors'] == [PAIR,PHASE,ROOT] and value['required_join'] == JOIN
         and value['root'] == ROOT and type(value['original_awards']) is int and value['original_awards'] == 0
         and value['full_g2'] == 'NOT_DISPATCHED_OR_CONSUMED_IN_THIS_HOST'
         and value['future_adoption'] == 'SEPARATE_GUARDED_RECEIVING_AND_OWNER_DECISION'
         and value['root_decision_before'] == BEFORE and value['result'] == 'HOST_SPECIFIC_OBLIGATION_CLOSURE_RECEIVED', 'PUBLIC_SCOPE_CREDIT')
    required = (('DG16','DG16_ORIGINAL_RECEIVING','ACTIVE_TARGET_ORIGINAL_QUALIFICATION_REMAINS'),
                ('DG17','DG17_INTERFACE_SCOPE','INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_OWNER_CE057_INTERFACE_ONLY'),
                ('DG18','DG18_INTERFACE_SCOPE','INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_OWNER_CE051_CHANGED_INPUT_ONLY'))
    need(type(value['scope_obligations']) is list and len(value['scope_obligations']) == 3, 'PUBLIC_OBLIGATION_POPULATION')
    for row,(cell,consumer,condition) in zip(value['scope_obligations'],required):
        exact(row,('cell','count','original_ids_sha256','consumer','condition','state'))
        need(row == dict(cell=cell,count=basis['original_population'][cell],original_ids_sha256=sha(encode(basis['original_ids'][cell])),
                         consumer=consumer,condition=condition,state='RETAINED_SCOPE_NOT_EXECUTED_BY_THIS_HOST'), 'PUBLIC_OBLIGATION_BINDING')
    need(encode(value) == raw, 'PUBLIC_CANONICAL_BYTES')
    return value


def ancestors(path):
    rows = []
    for parent in reversed(Path(path).absolute().parents):
        s = parent.lstat()
        # GitHub workspace ancestors may be genuinely runner-owned. Bind their
        # actual identity instead of manufacturing UID0 or changing ownership.
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode), 'HELD_ANCESTRY_NOT_ORDINARY')
        rows.append([str(parent), s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_uid, s.st_gid])
    return rows


def held_files(api):
    source, private, run_root, _ = context(api)
    g = private/'g3'
    names = [run_root/name for name in ('STATE.md', 'PROTOCOL.md', 'ROADMAP.md', 'THINKING.md',
                                      'sidecars.md', 'tools.md', 'context.md', 'phases/phase-1.md')]
    names += [source/COMPILER, source/OWNER]
    names += [g/'inputs'/name for name in ('G1_INPUTS.json', 'POLICY.json', 'ORIGINAL_SCOPE.json',
                                         'SCOPE_READER.py', 'COMPILER_READER.py', 'ADVERSE_APPLICABILITY.json',
                                         'NATIVE_PREREQUISITE_RECEIVING.json', *SCOPE_INPUT_NAMES)]
    names += [private/'NATIVE_PREREQUISITE_RECEIVING.json']
    names += [g/name for name in ('SELECTED_NATIVE.json', 'DISPATCH.json', 'TRANSITION.json', 'SCOPE_RETURN.json',
                                 'SCOPE_EXECUTION.json', 'BEFORE_PAIR_NATIVE.json', 'RETURN_NATIVE.json',
                                 'RESULTS.json', 'JOIN.json', 'EXECUTIONS.json', 'SELECTED_CANONICAL_INPUTS.json')]
    names += [private/name for name in ('G3_ROOT_REQUEST.json', 'G3_SCOPE_RECEIVING.json', 'RECEIVING.json')]
    names += [private/'operation'/name for name in ('RESULT.json', 'PRODUCER_RETURN.json',
                                                    'RECEIVED_RAW_COMPARISON.json', 'OWNED_EVIDENCE_INDEX.json')]
    rows, total = [], 0
    for path in names:
        raw = read_file(path)
        total += len(raw)
        need(total <= TOTAL_LIMIT and len(rows) < ENTRY_LIMIT, 'HELD_SUMMARY_AGGREGATE_BOUND')
        rows.append(dict(path=str(path), physical=identity(path.lstat()), bytes=len(raw),
                         sha256=sha(raw), ancestors=ancestors(path)))
    # This census is explicitly the held native/result summary population.
    # The actual complete G1 captures are reacquired by the unchanged original
    # reader callback; this list is not a substitute for that consumer.
    return rows

def execution_records(graph, dispatch, outputs):
    records = []
    for name in SELECTED:
        node_value = next(n for n in graph['nodes'] if n['id'] == name)
        reads = {p:graph['binding']['read_set'][p] for p in node_value['reads']+node_value['invalidators'] if p.startswith('path:')}
        records.append(dict(node=name, dispatch_id=dispatch['dispatch_id'], graph_digest=graph['digest'],
            input_digest=node_value['input_digest'], input_root_identity=graph['binding']['input_root_identity'],
            read_set=reads, output_digest=outputs[name], exit_code=0))

def validate_public_request(raw):
    value = parse(raw, REQUEST_LIMIT)
    exact(value, ('schema', 'authority', 'source_commit', 'source_tree', 'source_parent', 'run_id', 'attempt',
        'nonce', 'control_branch', 'control_path', 'root', 'join', 'original_scope_sha256', 'graph_sha256',
        'dispatch_sha256', 'transition_sha256', 'join_sha256', 'scope_return_sha256', 'g1_return_sha256',
        'complete_input_key', 'returned_nodes', 'issued_unix_ms', 'expires_unix_ms', 'hold_seconds',
        'shared_expires_unix_ms', 'shared_window_seconds',
        'decision_before', 'decision_after', 'original_total', 'original_awards', 'full_g2', 'status'))
    need(value['schema'] == 'dg16.g3-root-consumption-request.v2' and value['authority'] == 'NONE'
         and value['source_commit'] == SOURCE_COMMIT and value['source_tree'] == SOURCE_TREE
         and value['source_parent'] == SOURCE_PARENT, 'PUBLIC_REQUEST_SOURCE')
    need(type(value['run_id']) is str and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]{5,19}', value['run_id'])
         and type(value['attempt']) is int and value['attempt'] == 1
         and type(value['nonce']) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', value['nonce']), 'PUBLIC_REQUEST_IDENTITY')
    need(value['control_branch'] == CONTROL_BRANCH and value['control_path'] == CONTROL_PATH
         and value['root'] == ROOT and value['join'] == JOIN
         and value['original_scope_sha256'] == SCOPE_SHA, 'PUBLIC_REQUEST_ROUTE')
    for key in ('graph_sha256', 'dispatch_sha256', 'transition_sha256', 'join_sha256',
                'scope_return_sha256', 'g1_return_sha256', 'complete_input_key'):
        digest(value[key])
    hold = integer(value['hold_seconds'], 60, 300)
    start = integer(value['issued_unix_ms'], 1, 10**16)
    need(integer(value['expires_unix_ms'], 1, 10**16) == start+1000*hold, 'PUBLIC_REQUEST_HOLD')
    shared = integer(value['shared_window_seconds'], 180, HOLD_SECONDS)
    need(value['shared_expires_unix_ms'] == start+1000*shared and hold <= shared-120, 'SHARED_DECISION_WINDOW')
    need(value['returned_nodes'] == SELECTED and value['decision_before'] == BEFORE and value['decision_after'] == AFTER
         and type(value['original_total']) is int and value['original_total'] == 157
         and type(value['original_awards']) is int and value['original_awards'] == 0
         and value['full_g2'] == 'NOT_DISPATCHED_OR_CONSUMED_IN_THIS_HOST' and value['status'] == 'ROOT_REQUEST_READY', 'PUBLIC_REQUEST_SCOPE')
    need(encode(value) == raw, 'PUBLIC_CANONICAL_BYTES')
    return value

    need(scope['run_id'] == run and scope['graph_sha256'] == selected['digest'], 'ACTUAL_SCOPE_RETURN_IDENTITY')
    diagnostic.done('G1_RECEIVED')
    diagnostic.phase('JOIN')
    engine = compiler(source)
    returned_raw, current = observe(api, engine, inputs)
    outputs = {PAIR:received_sha, SCOPE:sha(scope_raw)}

        write_once(g/name, raw)
    diagnostic.done('JOIN_READY')
    diagnostic.phase('HOLD_READY')
    now = time.monotonic()
    shared_seconds = min(HOLD_SECONDS, int(api['deadline_monotonic']-now-RESUME_RESERVE_SECONDS))
    need(180 <= shared_seconds <= HOLD_SECONDS, 'INSUFFICIENT_CUSTODY_FOR_ROOT_HOLD')

    issued = int(time.time()*1000)
    request = dict(schema='dg16.g3-root-consumption-request.v2', authority='NONE', source_commit=SOURCE_COMMIT,
        source_tree=SOURCE_TREE, source_parent=SOURCE_PARENT, run_id=run, attempt=1, nonce=secrets.token_hex(16),
        control_branch=CONTROL_BRANCH, control_path=CONTROL_PATH, root=ROOT, join=JOIN, original_scope_sha256=SCOPE_SHA,
        graph_sha256=selected['digest'], dispatch_sha256=dispatch['dispatch_id'], transition_sha256=transition['digest'],
        join_sha256=sha(encode(joined)), scope_return_sha256=outputs[SCOPE], g1_return_sha256=outputs[PAIR],
        complete_input_key=key, returned_nodes=SELECTED, issued_unix_ms=issued,
        expires_unix_ms=issued+hold_seconds*1000, hold_seconds=hold_seconds,
        shared_expires_unix_ms=issued+shared_seconds*1000, shared_window_seconds=shared_seconds,
        decision_before=BEFORE, decision_after=AFTER, original_total=157, original_awards=0,
        full_g2='NOT_DISPATCHED_OR_CONSUMED_IN_THIS_HOST', status='ROOT_REQUEST_READY')
    request_raw = encode(request)
    validate_public_request(request_raw)
    write_once(private/'G3_ROOT_REQUEST.json', request_raw, REQUEST_LIMIT)
    write_once(private/'G3_SCOPE_RECEIVING.json', scope_raw, PUBLIC_LIMIT)
    held = held_files(api)
    hold = dict(schema='dg16.g3-private-hold.v1', request_sha256=sha(request_raw),
                expires_monotonic=now+hold_seconds, enclosing_deadline=api['deadline_monotonic'], held_files=held,
                shared_expires_monotonic=now+shared_seconds,
                held_input_names=sorted(p.name for p in inputs.iterdir()))
    write_once(g/'HOLD.json', encode(hold))
    diagnostic.done('REQUEST_RETAINED')
    return dict(status='ROOT_REQUEST_READY', request_sha256=sha(request_raw), scope_return_sha256=sha(scope_raw),
                hold_seconds=hold_seconds, original_awards=0)


def validate_decision(raw, request, request_sha, now_unix_ms):
    value = parse(raw, DECISION_LIMIT)
    exact(value, ('schema', 'issuer', 'action', 'request_sha256', 'run_id', 'attempt', 'nonce',
        'source_commit', 'source_tree', 'graph_sha256', 'dispatch_sha256', 'join_sha256', 'outputs',
        'consumed_nodes', 'decision_before', 'decision_after', 'owner_arrangement', 'full_g2',
        'original_awards', 'issued_unix_ms', 'expires_unix_ms'))
    need(value['schema'] == 'dg16.g3-root-consumption-decision.v2' and value['issuer'] == 'R5_ROOT_GOVERNOR'
         and value['action'] == 'CONSUME_COMPONENT_RETURNS_ONLY' and value['request_sha256'] == digest(request_sha),
         'ROOT_DECISION_ACTION_OR_REQUEST')
    for key in ('run_id', 'attempt', 'nonce', 'source_commit', 'source_tree', 'graph_sha256',
                'dispatch_sha256', 'join_sha256', 'decision_before', 'decision_after', 'full_g2', 'expires_unix_ms'):
        need(type(value[key]) is type(request[key]) and value[key] == request[key], 'ROOT_DECISION_BINDING')
    need(value['outputs'] == {PAIR:request['g1_return_sha256'], SCOPE:request['scope_return_sha256']}
         and value['consumed_nodes'] == SELECTED and value['owner_arrangement'] == OWNER_ARRANGEMENT
         and type(value['original_awards']) is int and value['original_awards'] == 0, 'ROOT_DECISION_SCOPE')
    issued = integer(value['issued_unix_ms'], request['issued_unix_ms'], request['expires_unix_ms'])
    need(issued <= now_unix_ms < request['expires_unix_ms'], 'ROOT_DECISION_EXPIRED_OR_FUTURE')
    need(encode(value) == raw, 'ROOT_DECISION_CANONICAL_BYTES')
    return value


class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        raise Refusal('CONTROL_REDIRECT_REFUSED')


def http_bytes(url, maximum, deadline):
    left = deadline-time.monotonic()
    need(left > 0, 'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept':'application/json',
        'Cache-Control':'no-cache', 'User-Agent':'implementaudit-reviewed-g3-receiver/1'})
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect())
    # urllib's socket timeout alone is not a whole-request deadline (including
    # DNS and a slow response). Temporarily shorten the existing main-thread
    # timer, preserving its remaining budget and handler on exit. No producer
    # owner or subprocess is live during this root-decision read.
    began = time.monotonic()
    old_handler = signal.getsignal(signal.SIGALRM)
    old_timer = signal.getitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL)
    own_deadline = old_timer[0] == 0 or left < old_timer[0]
    if own_deadline:
        def expired(_signum, _frame):
            raise Refusal('ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, expired)
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, left)
    try:
        with opener.open(request, timeout=min(HTTP_SECONDS, left)) as response:
            need(response.status == 200 and response.geturl() == url, 'CONTROL_HTTP_RESPONSE')
            size = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
            if size is not None:
                need(re.fullmatch('[0-9]{1,8}', size) and int(size) <= maximum, 'CONTROL_HTTP_BOUND')
            pieces = []
            total = 0
            while total <= maximum:
                need(time.monotonic() < deadline, 'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
                part = response.read1(min(4096, maximum+1-total))
                if not part:
                    break
                pieces.append(part)
                total += len(part)
            raw = b''.join(pieces)
            need(len(raw) <= maximum and time.monotonic() < deadline, 'CONTROL_HTTP_BOUND')
            return raw
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        if exc.code == 404:
            return None
        raise Refusal('CONTROL_HTTP_REFUSED') from None
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError):
        raise Refusal('CONTROL_TRANSPORT_REFUSED') from None
    finally:
        if own_deadline:
            signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
            signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, old_handler)
            if old_timer[0]:
                signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, max(0.000001, old_timer[0]-(time.monotonic()-began)), old_timer[1])


def read_root_decision(request, request_sha, deadline, final=False):
    ref_url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/'+REPOSITORY+'/git/ref/heads/'+CONTROL_BRANCH
    for _ in range(POLL_COUNT):
        need(time.monotonic() < deadline, 'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
        raw = http_bytes(ref_url, 8192, deadline)
        if raw is not None:
            ref = parse(raw, 8192)
            need(type(ref) is dict and ref.get('ref') == 'refs/heads/'+CONTROL_BRANCH
                 and type(ref.get('object')) is dict and ref['object'].get('type') == 'commit', 'CONTROL_REF_SHAPE')
            commit = ref['object'].get('sha')
            need(type(commit) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', commit), 'CONTROL_COMMIT_SHAPE')
            path = FINAL_CONTROL_PATH if final else CONTROL_PATH
            decision_raw = http_bytes('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/'+REPOSITORY+'/'+commit+'/'+path,
                                      16384 if final else DECISION_LIMIT, deadline)
            if decision_raw is not None:
                validate = validate_final_decision if final else validate_decision
                decision = validate(decision_raw, request, request_sha, int(time.time()*1000))
                need(time.monotonic() < deadline, 'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
                return decision_raw, decision, commit
        left = deadline-time.monotonic()
        need(left > 0, 'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
        time.sleep(min(POLL_SECONDS, left))
    raise Refusal('ROOT_HOLD_POLL_BOUND')


def owner_command(api, label, args, seconds=45):
    source = Path(api['source'])
    rc, out, err = api['command'](label, ['/usr/bin/bash', str(source/OWNER), *args], seconds=seconds)
    need(rc == 0 and not err, 'G3_MAINTAINED_OWNER_REFUSED')
    return out


def require_receipt(api, receipt, label):
    out = owner_command(api, label, ['--require-current-continuity', api['controller']])
    need(out.decode('ascii', 'strict').strip() == receipt, 'G3_CURRENT_RECEIPT_DIFFERS')
    return sha(out)


@guarded
def consume(api, diagnostic):
    source, private, run_root, run = context(api)
    g, inputs = private/'g3', private/'g3/inputs'
    need(not (g/'CONSUMPTION_RESERVED.json').exists(), 'ROOT_CONSUMPTION_ALREADY_RESERVED')
    request_raw = read_file(private/'G3_ROOT_REQUEST.json', REQUEST_LIMIT)
    request = validate_public_request(request_raw)
    scope_raw = read_file(private/'G3_SCOPE_RECEIVING.json', PUBLIC_LIMIT)
    validate_public_scope(scope_raw)
    held = parse(read_file(g/'HOLD.json'))
    need(held.get('schema') == 'dg16.g3-private-hold.v1' and held['request_sha256'] == sha(request_raw)
         and held['enclosing_deadline'] == api['deadline_monotonic'] and request['run_id'] == run
         and held['expires_monotonic'] <= api['deadline_monotonic']-RESUME_RESERVE_SECONDS,
         'PRIVATE_HOLD_BINDING')
    need(held_files(api) == held['held_files'] and sorted(p.name for p in inputs.iterdir()) == held['held_input_names'],
         'HELD_IDENTITY_OR_BYTES_CHANGED')
    diagnostic.phase('CONTROL_READ')
    decision_raw, decision, control_commit = read_root_decision(request, sha(request_raw), held['expires_monotonic'])
    diagnostic.done('ROOT_DECISION_READ')
    # Actual maintained readback and physical identity comparison occur after
    # the hold. A public decision or equal-byte replacement cannot skip either.
    need(actual_upstream(api, request['complete_input_key']) == request['g1_return_sha256'], 'G1_RETURN_CHANGED_DURING_HOLD')
    engine = compiler(source)
    native_raw, current = observe(api, engine, inputs)
    selected = parse(read_file(g/'SELECTED_NATIVE.json'))['projection']
    dispatch = parse(read_file(g/'DISPATCH.json'))
    results = parse(read_file(g/'RESULTS.json'))
    joined = engine.reconcile_native_results_v1(selected, current, dispatch, results, JOIN)
    need(sha(encode(joined)) == request['join_sha256'] and joined['status'] == 'SATISFIED_AT_DECLARED_RESULT_CONTRACT',
         'ROOT_JOIN_CHANGED_DURING_HOLD')
    need(held_files(api) == held['held_files'] and sorted(p.name for p in inputs.iterdir()) == held['held_input_names'],
         'HELD_IDENTITY_OR_BYTES_CHANGED')
    need(time.monotonic() < held['expires_monotonic'] and int(time.time()*1000) < request['expires_unix_ms'],
         'ROOT_HOLD_EXPIRED')
    diagnostic.phase('RESERVE')
    diagnostic.start('reservation')
    write_once(g/'CONSUMPTION_RESERVED.json', encode(dict(schema='dg16.g3-one-shot-reservation.v1',
        request_sha256=sha(request_raw), root_decision_sha256=sha(decision_raw), control_commit=control_commit,
        nonce=request['nonce'], attempt=1)))
    diagnostic.done('CONSUMPTION_RESERVED')
    diagnostic.phase('ROOT_CONSUME')
    diagnostic.start('root_consumption')
    write_once(g/'ROOT_DECISION.json', decision_raw, DECISION_LIMIT)
    write_once(g/'G1_PREBOUNDARY_INPUTS.json', encode(dict(
        scope='ACTUAL_MAINTAINED_ACQUIRE_ALL_SOURCE_GIT_HIDDEN_AND_RUNTIME',
        complete_input_key=request['complete_input_key'], current_generation='G0001',
        root_consumption_decision_sha256=sha(decision_raw),
        actual_canonical_population_sha256=sha(read_file(g/'SELECTED_CANONICAL_INPUTS.json')),
        g1_receiving_sha256=request['g1_return_sha256'], complete_readback_before_and_after_raw_receiver=True)))
    write_once(g/'CONSUMING_NATIVE.json', native_raw)
    executions = parse(read_file(g/'EXECUTIONS.json'))
    transition = parse(read_file(g/'TRANSITION.json'))
    consumptions = [dict(node=row['node'], consumer=JOIN, condition=CONDITION,
        input_digest=row['input_digest'], input_root_identity=row['input_root_identity'],
        read_set_digest=sha(engine.canonical_json_v1(row['read_set'])),
        output_digest=row['output_digest'], decision_before=decision['decision_before'], decision_after=decision['decision_after'])
        for row in executions]
    checked = engine.check_recursive_execution_v1(selected, [], transition, executions, consumptions)
    need(checked['status'] == 'PORTABLE_RECORDS_CONSUMED' and checked['native_campaign_proven'] is False
         and checked['consumed'] == SELECTED, 'RECURSIVE_RECORD_CONSUMPTION_REFUSED')
    # Leave the pure checker's authority and evidence level unchanged. Actual
    # process custody, native observations and root control are separate records.
    write_once(g/'CONSUMPTIONS.json', encode(consumptions))
    write_once(g/'RECURSIVE_RECORD_CHECK.json', encode(checked))
    diagnostic.done('ROOT_CONSUMED')
    completion = {PAIR:request['g1_return_sha256'], SCOPE:request['scope_return_sha256'], JOIN:request['join_sha256']}
    before = {name:read_file(run_root/name, CANONICAL_LIMIT) for name in DOCS}
    updated = render_fences(run_root, declarations(run, completion), False)
    diagnostic.phase('INVALIDATE')
    diagnostic.start('invalidation')
    invalid = owner_command(api, 'g3-invalidate-for-root-join', ['--invalidate-continuity', api['controller'],
        '--boundary', 'manual-resume', '--event', 'g3-root-consumed-'+run+'-'+request['nonce']])
    need(re.fullmatch('refs/implementaudit/continuity-invalidations/'+re.escape(api['controller'])+r'@[0-9a-f]{40}',
                      invalid.decode('ascii','strict').strip()), 'G3_INVALIDATION_TOKEN')
    write_once(g/'INVALIDATION.read', invalid, 4096)
    diagnostic.done('INVALIDATED')
    diagnostic.phase('CANONICAL_UPDATE')
    diagnostic.start('canonical_update')
    for name in DOCS:
        update_existing(run_root/name, before[name], updated[name])
    diagnostic.done('CANONICAL_UPDATED')
    # Separate, exact current canonical reads precede ordinary supported resume.
    write_once(g/'RESUME_STATE.read', read_file(run_root/'STATE.md', CANONICAL_LIMIT), CANONICAL_LIMIT)
    write_once(g/'RESUME_ROADMAP.read', read_file(run_root/'ROADMAP.md', CANONICAL_LIMIT), CANONICAL_LIMIT)
    diagnostic.phase('RESUME')
    diagnostic.start('resume_currentness')
    need(type(api['receipt']) is str and re.fullmatch('refs/implementaudit/continuity-receipts/'
         +re.escape(api['controller'])+r'/G0001@[0-9a-f]{40}', api['receipt']), 'G3_INITIAL_GENERATION')
    resumed = owner_command(api, 'g3-resume-after-root-join', ['--resume-controller', api['controller'],
        '--boundary', 'manual-resume', '--epoch', 'G0002'])
    receipt = resumed.decode('ascii', 'strict').strip()
    need(re.fullmatch('refs/implementaudit/continuity-receipts/'+re.escape(api['controller'])+r'/G0002@[0-9a-f]{40}', receipt),
         'G3_NEW_RECEIPT_SHAPE')
    verified = owner_command(api, 'g3-verify-new-receipt', ['--verify-resume-receipt', receipt])
    need(verified.decode('ascii', 'strict').strip() == receipt, 'G3_NEW_RECEIPT_VERIFY')
    require_receipt(api, receipt, 'g3-require-new-currentness')
    write_once(g/'NEW_RECEIPT.read', resumed, 4096)
    diagnostic.done('NEW_CURRENTNESS')
    diagnostic.phase('REDERIVE')
    diagnostic.start('frontier_recomputation')
    next_api = dict(api, receipt=receipt, require_current=lambda label:require_receipt(api, receipt, label))
    final_raw, final_graph = observe(next_api, engine, inputs)
    final_transition = engine.compile_recursive_transition_v1(final_graph, [checked['event_receipt']])
    need(final_transition['selected'] == [] and final_transition['ancestors'] == [JOIN, PHASE, ROOT]
         and final_graph['binding']['epoch'] == 'G0002', 'POST_JOIN_FRONTIER_REFUSED')
    nodes = {row['id']:row for row in final_graph['nodes']}
    need(all(nodes[name]['state'] == 'DONE' for name in (PAIR, SCOPE, JOIN))
         and all(nodes[name]['state'] != 'DONE' for name in (ROOT,PHASE,'DG17_INTERFACE_SCOPE','DG18_INTERFACE_SCOPE',
                  'FULL_G2_RECEIVING','DG16_ORIGINAL_RECEIVING','COMMON_ADOPTION_RECEIVING',
                  'RESERVED_SOURCE_ADOPTION','RESERVED_DG16_CERTIFICATION')),
         'POST_JOIN_ANCESTOR_OR_SIBLING_CREDIT')
    write_once(g/'FINAL_NATIVE.json', final_raw)
    write_once(g/'FINAL_TRANSITION.json', encode(final_transition))
    diagnostic.done('FRONTIER_RECOMPUTED')
    diagnostic.phase('STALE_RETURN')
    stale = engine.reconcile_native_results_v1(selected, final_graph, dispatch, results, JOIN)
    need(stale['status'] == 'RECOMPUTE_REQUIRED' and all(name in stale['invalidated'] for name in SELECTED),
         'ACTUAL_STALE_RETURN_NOT_REFUSED')
    write_once(g/'STALE_RETURN.json', encode(stale))
    # Matched negative uses the same real before/after snapshots without another
    # dispatch or root effect. Its result is read-only comparator discrimination.
    missing = engine.reconcile_native_results_v1(selected, selected, dispatch, results[:1], JOIN)
    need(missing['status'] == 'PENDING' and missing['missing'] == [SCOPE], 'MISSING_RETURN_NOT_PENDING')
    write_once(g/'MISSING_RETURN_CONTROL.json', encode(missing))
    diagnostic.done('STALE_RETURN_REFUSED')
    diagnostic.phase('FINAL_REQUEST')
    prepare_final_request(next_api, request, held, selected, final_graph, diagnostic)
    return dict(status='ROOT_CONSUMED_SCOPED_RETURNS', receipt=receipt, root_decision_sha256=sha(decision_raw),
        request_sha256=sha(request_raw), native_final_graph_sha256=final_graph['digest'],
        native_final_transition_sha256=final_transition['digest'], pure_record_status=checked['status'],
        stale_return_status=stale['status'], original_awards=0, full_g2=False, whole_cell_ready=False)

        integer(value[key],0,1800*10**9)

def final_census(api):
    _, private, _, _ = context(api)
    rows = held_files(api)
    for name in ('FINAL_NATIVE.json','FINAL_TRANSITION.json','STALE_RETURN.json','MISSING_RETURN_CONTROL.json',
                 'ROOT_DECISION.json','CONSUMPTIONS.json','RECURSIVE_RECORD_CHECK.json','NEW_RECEIPT.read',
                 'G1_PREBOUNDARY_INPUTS.json','SELECTED_CANONICAL_INPUTS.json','INDEPENDENT_INPUT_BOOKENDS.json'):
        path = private/'g3'/name
        raw = read_file(path)
        rows.append(dict(path=str(path),physical=identity(path.lstat()),bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw),ancestors=ancestors(path)))
    raw = read_file(private/'G3_FINAL_REQUEST.json', 16384)
    path = private/'G3_FINAL_REQUEST.json'
    rows.append(dict(path=str(path),physical=identity(path.lstat()),bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw),ancestors=ancestors(path)))
    path = private/'G3_INDEPENDENT_PROOF_RECEIPT.json'
    raw = read_file(path, 16384)
    rows.append(dict(path=str(path),physical=identity(path.lstat()),bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw),ancestors=ancestors(path)))
    need(sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows) <= TOTAL_LIMIT and len(rows) <= ENTRY_LIMIT, 'FINAL_HELD_SUMMARY_BOUND')
    return rows

        component_return_nodes=SELECTED, consumed_join=JOIN, root=ROOT,

        g3_current_scope='CURRENT_G0002_AFTER_SUPPORTED_ROOT_CONSUMPTION_AND_REDERIVATION',
        input_change_reason='ACTUAL_CAPTURE_INCLUDES_CANONICAL_FILES_CHANGED_BY_ROOT_JOIN_AND_OWNER_GENERATION',
        retained_original_total=157, actual_original_awards='ROOT_DECISION_PENDING',

        shared_window_started_unix_ms=initial['issued_unix_ms'], issued_unix_ms=int(time.time()*1000),
        expires_unix_ms=initial['shared_expires_unix_ms'], shared_window_seconds=initial['shared_window_seconds'],
        status='FINAL_ROOT_DECISION_REQUIRED_WHILE_CURRENT')

    validate_public_final_request(raw)
    write_once(private/'G3_FINAL_REQUEST.json',raw,16384)
